dashboard.inboxExportEmpty: 这个视图里没有可导出的内容。
dashboard.inboxNoMatchesHint: 换个过滤条件或搜索词试试
dashboard.inboxNoteAll: 所有等着你拿主意的东西。已暂缓的不在这里——时间一到它们会自己回来。
dashboard.inboxNoteUnread: 你还没打开、也还没保留的链接。打开一个就算已读；用 r 保留则不打开也算已读。
dashboard.inboxNoteSnoozed: 按你挑的时间搁置起来，最快到期的排在前面。它们在唤醒之前不出现在其他过滤条件里，「立即唤醒」可以提前把一个拉回来。
dashboard.inboxNoteNoted: 你写过备注的链接——记下当初为什么存它，好应付光看标题已经想不起来的时候。
dashboard.inboxExplainWhat: 一个暂存区，放那些值得留下、但还不知道该归到哪儿的链接。往仪表板上粘一个网址，它会落到这里、直接变成书签，或者问你要哪种——取决于你在「行为」里选的。浏览器扩展也能存到这里，已经在收件箱里的网址会被挡回去，而不是重复一份。
dashboard.inboxExplainRead: 新链接在你打开它、或用 r 保留它之前都算未读。已读的链接仍留在列表里——读过并不构成移除的理由——等你真的处理完了，用「清除已读」一次删掉。标签上的数字只数未读且已唤醒的。
dashboard.inboxExplainSnooze: 暂缓会把一个链接藏到你选定的时间，好让列表只剩下你现在就能动手的东西。休眠中的链接不计入除「已暂缓」以外的任何计数和过滤条件，时间一过就自己回来。
dashboard.inboxExplainPromote: 「转为书签」把一个链接变成真正的书签，会打开完整表单，页面和分类留给你选。书签一保存，收件箱里的那条就消失，所以不会同一样东西存在两个地方。
dashboard.inboxExplainTriage: 分拣让你不用鼠标、一次一条地走完列表。把排序改成最早在前是另一条路子：收件箱是从底部清干净的，你躲了很久的链接都在那儿。过滤、排序和搜索都会出现在地址栏里，所以任何一个视图都能存成书签或分享出去。
dashboard.inboxEmptyAllHint: 没有待处理的。往仪表板上粘个网址，就能存一个留着以后看。
dashboard.inboxEmptyUnreadHint: 都跟上进度了。已读的链接会留在「全部」里，直到你清除它们。
dashboard.inboxEmptySnoozedHint: 按 z 暂缓一个链接，把它搁到你选定的时间。它会自己回来。
dashboard.inboxEmptyNotedHint: 在链接上按 n，记下你为什么存它，好应付光看标题已经想不起来的时候。
dashboard.stepPagesOverviewBody: 按「,」或点页面按钮，就能看到每个页面及其书签数量——页面多的时候很好用。

dashboard.analyticsNoticeBody: 使用统计目前是关闭的。打开后会分享匿名的使用数据，好让人看清哪些功能被用到、哪些还能改进——绝不会包含书签名称、网址或搜索内容。你随时可以再关掉。
dashboard.analyticsNoticeWhyBody: nextDash 一直不清楚自己实际是怎么被使用的。大家会打开哪些视图？有人用查找器、标签云或收件箱吗？添加书签时人们通常在哪一步放弃？没有答案，每一次改进都只是猜测。这些统计正好回答这些问题——哪些功能被用到、哪里还能做得更好——除此之外什么都不做。它无意跟着你跑：它纯粹是对操作流程和功能使用的抽象技术测量，并且是所有人汇总在一起的。打开它帮助很大，哪怕只开几天也好——一小段真实使用胜过几个月的猜测，之后你完全可以再关掉。
dashboard.analyticsNoticeNeverBody: 不记录书签名称、网址、搜索词、页面或分类名称、备注和标签。不设置任何 cookie，不建立个人画像，也不会跨网站追踪你。可能泄露信息的计数会归入区间取整，而且实例是自托管的，因此不会有任何数据流向广告网络。
dashboard.analyticsNoticeOnBody: 前往 配置 → 行为 → 隐私，勾选「注重隐私的使用统计」，或者在命令面板中运行 :telemetry on。页面重新加载后生效。关闭期间统计脚本根本不会加载，也不会有任何请求离开你的机器。

dashboard.freshNoticeBody: 博客、更新日志、状态页——nextDash 可以在自你上次打开以来有更新的书签上加一个小计数，并把它们汇总到「新动态」合集里。它不保存文章；那只是个计数，不是阅读器。
dashboard.freshTutorialEnabled: 新动态已开启。订阅源读取后计数就会出现。
dashboard.freshTutorialStep1Title: 给有更新的行加个计数
dashboard.freshTutorialStep1Body1: 你保存的有些页面会持续更新：博客、更新日志、论坛、状态页。光看那一行看不出来，于是你要么碰运气点开，要么干脆不再点。
dashboard.freshTutorialStep1Body2: 开启新动态后，只要一个书签对应的页面自你上次打开以来有过更新，它就会带上一个小计数。打开它，计数就清零。你要做的就这些。
dashboard.freshTutorialStep2Title: 还有一个把它们汇总起来的合集
dashboard.freshTutorialStep2Body1: 这些书签会汇总到分类之间的「新动态」合集里，最新发布的排在前面，标题上带着数量。只有真的有新内容时它才出现——空的「新动态」是个毫无意义的分区。
dashboard.freshTutorialStep2Body2: 它和别的合集一样：可以折叠，里面的行就是真正的书签，所以在那里编辑一个，处处都会跟着变。
dashboard.freshTutorialStep3Body1: 开启新动态时会去找订阅源：读取你保存的每个页面的头部，记下那里声明的订阅源，并记住哪些页面没有，一个月内不再问它们。也就是每个书签一次请求，仅此一次。
dashboard.freshTutorialStep3Body2: 之后已知的订阅源每小时问一次，而且每次只问有没有变化——安静的站点用几百字节回答「没有」。持续失败的订阅源会被停用，而不是无休止地重试。
dashboard.freshTutorialNotReader: 大多数保存下来的页面根本没有订阅源。配置 → 行为 → 新动态 会告诉你你这边有多少个有。
dashboard.freshTutorialStep4Body1: 一片空白才是常见的结果，这不是故障：商店、维基页面、登录页什么都不发布。「新动态」标签页会替你数出来——「40 个书签中问过 12 个 · 2 个有订阅源」——还有「立即查找订阅源」，方便你保存了新东西之后再看一遍。
dashboard.freshTutorialStep4Body2: 而且新动态不是订阅阅读器：没有文章、没有标题、也没有自己的已读状态——只有比你上次访问更新的条目数量。开关在 配置 → 行为 → 新动态，它在「收件箱」和「状态与健康」之间自成一个标签页。
dashboard.spreadNoticeBody: 长分类不必再比邻居高出一大截：让它横跨，书签就会铺在两三列里，而不是在一列里往下堆。占几列会替你算好。
dashboard.spreadTutorialStep1Body1: 分类通常待在一列里往下长。长的那个于是比邻居高出一截，超出上限的书签也藏进了「+ N 个」后面。
dashboard.spreadTutorialStep1Body2: 让它横跨，同样这些书签就铺在两三列里——高度和周围齐平，一眼能看到的更多。这很适合那些由许多短条目组成的分类。
dashboard.spreadTutorialStep2Title: 就在分类所在的位置打开它
dashboard.spreadTutorialStep2Body1: 右键点分类标题选「横跨多列」，或者在分类获得焦点时按 Shift+W。立即生效——不用重新加载，也不用进设置页。
dashboard.spreadTutorialStep2Body2: 开启后同一个菜单项会变成「恢复为单列」，进去的路就是出来的路。每个分类各自决定，邻居不受影响。
dashboard.spreadTutorialStep3Body1: 横跨的分类占多宽，由两个你已经设过的值推出来：「每个分类的条目数」决定一列有多高，再加上分类里有多少书签。四十个书签、每列十五个，就要三列。
dashboard.spreadTutorialStep3Body2: 所以加书签时它会变宽，删书签时会变窄，而且永远不会超过网格的列数。这也意味着只要还有分类在横跨，「每个分类的条目数」就不能设成「不限」——没有列高，就没什么能决定该占几列。
dashboard.spreadTutorialStep4Body1: 配置 → 页面与标签 → 分类 里每一行都有同样的开关，做成一个 ↔ 按钮，一口气过完整页时那样更快。
dashboard.spreadTutorialStep4Body2: 在 外观 → 布局 下是对所有分类都生效的设置：新分类是否默认横跨，以及一个把横跨重新关掉的按钮——针对本页或所有页面。
dashboard.spreadTutorialWhereRow: 在 页面与标签 → 分类 中逐行设置
dashboard.spreadTutorialWhereConfig: 外观 → 布局 → 分类横跨多列
dashboard.categorySpreadUnavailable: 目前只有一列可用——横跨至少需要两列。
dashboard.categorySpreadUnavailableShort: 这里每个分类只有一列
dashboard.categorySpreadNeedsLimit: 横跨需要给每个分类设定条目上限——正是这个上限决定了一个分类占几列。请在 配置 → 外观 → 布局 中设置。
dashboard.categorySpreadNeedsLimitShort: 需要设定每个分类的条目上限
dashboard.healthReportAgeTitle: 这份报告是什么时候生成的。用「全部重测」可以刷新它。
dashboard.healthHeaderTitleHint: 这个视图列出需要处理的书签：失效的链接、内容不再符合预期的页面，以及离线的监控。上方的路径显示当前的过滤条件。
dashboard.healthTrendHelpWhat: 回溯 {days} 天，每一天你的书签里算得上健康的比例。
dashboard.healthTrendHelpAxis: 坐标轴固定在 0–100%，所以只有数字真的动了，线才会动。一批一直在 91% 到 93% 之间的书签在这里看着是平的，这才是诚实的画法——按数据范围缩放会把它画成断崖。
dashboard.healthTrendHelpGaps: 健康报告运行时才会记下一个读数，所以你没打开 nextDash 的日子会留下空档，线会断开，而不是凭空连过去。
dashboard.healthTrendHelpHealthy: 「健康」的意思是：开了检查的能访问、最近打开过、并且不和别的书签冲突——和「健康」磁贴数的是同一条规则。
dashboard.healthSettingsLinkHint: 检查间隔、告警阈值、维护时段和离线告警
dashboard.healthTrendChartLabel: 最近 {days} 天的健康书签比例，从 {first}% 到 {last}%
dashboard.healthFleetExpand: 显示可用性最低的监控和中断记录
dashboard.healthFleetCollapse: 隐藏可用性最低的监控和中断记录，只留在线率磁贴
dashboard.healthFleetIncidentsMore: 显示 {total} 个中的 {shown} 个
dashboard.healthExplainScore: 每个书签都从 100 分起算，每有一处不对就扣一些分——无法访问、从未打开、地址重复、快捷方式冲突。点某一行上的徽标，或者按 s，就能看到它到底被扣在哪儿。
dashboard.healthExplainTiles: 一个书签可以同时是好几种情况，所以一个既重复、又从未打开过的书签会被两个磁贴都数进去，在两个过滤条件下都出现。而那一行本身只显示它最严重的问题，颜色和它在列表中的位置都由此决定。
dashboard.healthExplainFresh: 报告在服务器上生成并缓存几分钟，所以标题栏会说它有多旧。「全部重测」会重建报告，并重新测试所有开了检查的书签。
dashboard.healthExplainUptime: 只有监控中的书签才保留历史。百分比后面跟着它背后的检查次数，因为三次检查得出的 100% 远不如三百次得出的 100% 有说服力。某个时间窗内一次检查都没有，会写「无数据」而不是 0%。
dashboard.healthExplainFleet: 在「监控中」这个过滤条件下，列表上方的面板会把所有监控汇总。它的在线率是按单次检查来算的，而不是把每个监控的百分比取平均，所以一个只有三次记录的监控压不过一个有三千次的。
dashboard.healthExplainTrend: 你每打开这个视图的一天记录一个点，保留 90 天。线画在固定的 0–100 刻度上，所以一批在 91% 到 93% 之间的书签看着就该有多平就有多平；你没来的日子会留下空档，而不是拿一条直线穿过去。
dashboard.healthNoteBroken: 这些在上次检查时没有响应。重新检查其中一个可以现在再测一遍，或者干脆打开看看。
dashboard.healthNoteDuplicate: 两个或更多书签指向同一个地址。合并会保留一行，并把另一行的标签和备注并进来。
dashboard.healthNoteUnchecked: 这些开着检查，但最近没跑过——所以它们的状态是未知，而不是有问题。
dashboard.healthNoteMonitored: 这些由服务器按各自的间隔检查，在线率历史和下面那个面板就是这么来的。
dashboard.healthNoteStale: 这些你以前打开过，但最近 30 天没有。它们本身没什么毛病——只是适合收拾一下的候选。
dashboard.healthNoteUnused: 这些自添加以来从没打开过。往往值得留着，有时值得删掉，但总归值得看一眼。
dashboard.healthNoteShortcutConflict: 不止一个书签占用了同一个键盘快捷方式，所以按下去等于在它们之间掷硬币。
dashboard.healthNoteOrphanedCategory: 这些指向的分类在它们的页面上已经不存在了，通常是因为分类被删掉时没有先把它们挪走。它们仍然能用，但在仪表板上会和未分类的挤在一起——编辑某一行，把它归到一个还存在的地方。
dashboard.healthNoteMissingPreview: 还没有抓到标题、描述或图片，所以这些行除了地址之外没什么可看的。
dashboard.healthNoteCertificates: 这些所在主机的 TLS 证书即将过期。上面的数字是主机数；这个列表是它们上面的书签。
dashboard.healthNoteHealthy: 这些没什么毛病：开了检查的能访问、最近打开过、也不和任何东西冲突。
dashboard.healthTileContentHint: 站点有回应，但回的不是这个书签所期待的
dashboard.healthTileCertsHint: TLS 证书即将过期的主机——受影响的行会带徽标
dashboard.healthTileDriftHint: 页面不再是保存下来的那个样子了——重定向、标题或内容有变
dashboard.healthCertExpiredHint: {host} 的 TLS 证书已过期
dashboard.healthCertExpiringHint: {host} 的 TLS 证书将在 {days} 天后过期
dashboard.healthCheckUrlNote: 书签本身打开的还是它自己的地址。当一个服务有状态接口、但首页需要登录时，这很有用。
dashboard.healthCredentialNote: 密钥和密码存在单独的文件里，不进你的备份。可在 配置 → 健康 中管理。
dashboard.healthAllowInsecure: 接受本机不信任的证书
dashboard.healthExpectMenuHint: 关键词、状态码、腐化监视和告警
dashboard.healthExpectIntro: 可达性检查只问主机有没有回应。这里说的是：对这个页面来说，怎样才算一个好回应。
dashboard.healthExpectStatusNote: 留空表示 500 以下的都算可访问。
dashboard.healthWatchDrift: 监视重定向、改标题和内容改写
dashboard.healthNotifyMutedHint: 这个书签的告警已关闭。它仍会被检查，也仍会显示在这里。
dashboard.healthBulkAcceptDriftTitle: 接受 {count} 个书签的偏移？
dashboard.healthBulkAcceptDriftConfirm: 这会告诉 nextDash：这些页面现在这个样子就是对的。相关发现会被清除，下一次检查会记录一条新的基线。
dashboard.healthBulkAcceptDriftDone: 已接受 {count} 个书签的偏移
dashboard.healthBulkAcceptDriftPartial: 已接受 {count} 个；有 {skipped} 个已变动——请重新加载报告
dashboard.healthBulkAcceptDriftFailed: 无法接受这些偏移发现
dashboard.healthFocusHint: 一次一个书签地把这个列表过一遍
dashboard.healthFocusLegend: j / k 移动，Escape 退出
dashboard.healthFocusEmpty: 这个过滤条件下没有要处理的。
dashboard.healthFocusDone: 这个列表里没有剩下的了。
dashboard.healthReviewProgress: 复查 · {total} 中的第 {position} 个
dashboard.healthReviewDoneCount: 你处理了 {total} 个中的 {handled} 个。
dashboard.healthReviewDoneRest: 还有 {count} 个想看一眼，改天吧。
dashboard.healthReviewNoticeBody: 两分钟，一次一个：重新检查、打开，或者放手。
dashboard.healthDriftGeneric: 这个页面不再是保存下来的那个样子了。
dashboard.healthTutorialStep1Title: 健康视图能管的不只是「它还活着吗」
dashboard.healthTutorialStep1Body1: 这个版本加了几项检查：盯住一个悄悄变了样的页面、不该惊动任何人的计划内停机，以及能落到 Slack、Discord、Telegram、Pushover 或 ntfy 的告警，而不是没人看的裸 webhook。
dashboard.healthTutorialStep1Body2: 下面用一个例子把这些走一遍——一个你自己托管的状态页。六个小步骤，然后就完事了。以后想再看一遍，配置 → 帮助 → 健康 里有同样的说明。
dashboard.healthTutorialStep2Body1: 右键点一个书签，或者打开它的编辑器，把可用性检查从「定期」改成「持续监控」。这是你自己的服务器——不管仪表板开没开着，都值得按时看一眼。
dashboard.healthTutorialStep2Body2: 设成监控之后会出现「检查间隔」这一行。别人指望着的状态页，该比个人博客盯得紧一些——5 分钟是个合理的起点。
dashboard.healthTutorialStep3Title: 告诉它「正常」到底是什么意思
dashboard.healthTutorialStep3Body1: 这个状态页在登录之后，所以检查没有会话时它总是回 401——这很正常，不是故障。在「算作健康的状态码」里填 200,401，就不会让真正的中断淹没在意料之中的 401 里。
dashboard.healthTutorialStep3Body2: 如果这个页面只在它所报告的服务确实健康时才显示某句话——比如「All systems operational」——那么「页面必须包含的文字」就能抓住一个加载正常、却在悄悄报告自己出事的页面。
dashboard.healthTutorialStep4Title: 盯住整个页面换了样子的情况
dashboard.healthTutorialStep4Body1: 「监视重定向、改标题和内容改写」会记下一条基线：链接通向哪里、页面叫什么、大致说了些什么——勾上之后在下一次检查时确定。
dashboard.healthTutorialStep4Body2: 一个过期的域名，或者一个悄悄开始把流量送去别处的代理，会从上面那些状态码和关键词规则底下一路溜过去，因为请求根本就没到达真正的页面。这一项检查仍然能发现。
dashboard.healthTutorialStep5Body1: 这个服务每晚 3 点为了备份重启一次。没有维护时段的话，光这一件事每天夜里就要生成一次中断和一次告警——这样过上一星期，一次真正的凌晨 3 点故障看起来和前面六次毫无意义的一模一样。
dashboard.healthTutorialStep5Body2: 配置 → 行为 → 状态与健康 → 维护时段 需要一个星期几、一个开始时间和一个结束时间。检查照跑，心跳照记——只是把告警按住不发。
dashboard.healthTutorialStep6Body1: 「离线告警」现在有了服务选择器，所以消息会落到一个真能读的地方，而不是一大块聊天应用会默默丢掉的裸 JSON。挑你团队本来就在看的那个——只会显示那个服务需要的字段。
dashboard.healthTutorialStep6Body2: 把「连续几次后告警」设成 3，这样一次抖动漏掉的检查不至于惊动谁；在真正指望它之前先点一次「发送测试告警」——聊天 ID 填错的话它会悄无声息地失败，屏幕上不会有任何提示。
dashboard.healthTutorialStep6Closing: 整个循环就是这样：一条心跳条、一个在线率百分比，以及一条你真的看得到的消息——而且只在真出事的时候。
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep1Title: 一个放「还没拿定主意」的链接的地方
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep1Body1: 不是每个值得留下的链接都已经有页面和分类等着它。往仪表板上粘一个网址，它会——取决于 配置 → 行为 里的「粘贴去向」——落到这里、直接变成书签，或者问你要哪种。浏览器扩展也能存到这里，已经在等着的网址会被挡回去，而不是存两遍。
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep1Body2: 这里的东西都还不是书签，而且什么都不会过期。让一个链接躺一星期没有任何代价——这个列表就是干这个的。七个小步骤，你就会知道从它出来的每一条路。
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep2Body1: 新链接在你打开它或按 r 之前都算未读。打开即标为已读；按 r 则不打开也标为已读，这是对一个你已经认得的链接快速说一句「对，我还要它」的办法。
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep2Body2: 已读的链接留在列表里。读过一样东西不构成把它扔掉的理由，所以移除是另一件需要你主动做的事——工具栏里的「清除已读」一次全删。收件箱标签上的数字只数未读且已唤醒的，所以已读或已暂缓的东西不会一直烦你。
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep3Title: 把不属于今天的暂缓掉
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep3Body1: z 会把一个链接藏到你挑的时间——3 小时后、明天、本周末、下周，或者你自己定的日期。休眠期间它不出现在除「已暂缓」以外的任何过滤条件和计数里，时间一到就自己回来。「立即唤醒」可以提前把它拉回来。
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep3Body2: 这个习惯是让列表保持诚实的关键。一个塞满你此刻动不了的东西的收件箱，就是一个你会不再去看的收件箱——所以如果一个链接确实是下个月的事，就把它暂缓到下个月，而不是先从它旁边划过三十次。
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep4VisualNote: 给限流那一节用的——和另一个方案对比一下
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep4Body1: n 给链接留一条备注。两周之后，光看标题很少说得清它当初为什么重要，而一个你连自己都解释不了的链接，最后往往会被没读就删掉。一行就够。
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep4Body2: 「有备注」这个过滤条件会把你注解过的东西聚在一起，于是一份做了一半的资料可以整批捡回来，而不用一行行地找。转为书签时备注会跟着链接进到书签表单里，所以在它变成永久的那一刻，理由不会丢。
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep5Title: 「转为书签」把链接变成真正的书签
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep5VisualHint: 打开完整的书签表单，页面和分类仍由你来挑
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep5Body1: p 会打开书签表单，网址、标题和备注都已经填好，只留下收件箱刻意推迟的那一个决定：放哪个页面、哪个分类。标签、图标、描述和健康检查也都在，和新建任何书签一样。
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep5Body2: 书签一保存，收件箱里那条就消失，所以不会同一样东西存在两个地方。如果你更想留一份「经手过什么」的记录，就在「行为」里关掉「转为书签后删除」，转过的链接会留下来并标为已读。取消表单则什么都不改——链接还在原处待着。
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep6Title: 分拣：整批积压，不碰鼠标
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep6Body1: 一行一行地对四十个链接拿主意之所以慢，多半是因为屏幕上别的东西太多。t 会把单个链接摆在你面前，周围什么都没有：j 和 k 移动，o 或 Enter 打开，r 保留，z 暂缓，n 备注，p 转为书签，d 删除，Escape 退出。每个决定一次按键，下一个链接已经在那儿了。
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep6Body2: 开始之前先把排序设成最早在前。收件箱是从底部清干净的，你躲了一个月的链接都在那儿；顶部那部分看着还有意思，却从来不真的需要你。
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep7Title: 选择、收窄，以及把视图分享出去
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep7Body1: x 勾选一行，Shift 加方向键扩展选择，Ctrl/Cmd+A 拿下当前列出的全部——然后工具栏的操作就对整批生效。批量转为书签是值得知道的例外：它只问一次这些链接该放哪个页面，然后一起归档，而不是把表单打开四十遍。
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep7Body2: 「站点」下拉框把列表收窄到单个域名，你会因此发现某一份订阅邮件悄悄占了你收件箱的三分之一。过滤、排序、搜索和站点都会出现在地址栏里，所以收件箱的任何一个视图都能存成书签，或者发给另一台机器上的自己。
dashboard.inboxTutorialStep7Closing: 整个循环就是这样：链接落到一个地方，再以书签、暂缓或删除的方式离开——绝不会因为被悄悄遗忘而消失。

dashboard.inboxMarkAllReadHint: 标记收件箱里每一个未读链接

dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep1Title: 一个回答「现在什么情况」的区块
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep1Body1: 一整面链接回答的是「我要去哪儿」。小组件回答另一个问题：有多少在排队、什么挂了、磁盘满到什么程度。它就待在你的分类之间，像分类一样拖着放，宽度是一列或两列。
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep1Body2: 它们大多完全不用配置。其中一个——自定义小组件——可以指向你网络里任何用 JSON 回答的地址，这样你自己跑的服务就和指向它们的链接并排出现在同一页上。六个小步骤。
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep2Title: 十三种磁贴，读的都是 nextDash 已经存着的东西
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep2Body1: 健康、在线率、证书和趋势报告的就是健康视图报告的内容。收件箱说有什么在等着，订阅源说哪个源安静了，导入源说哪次导入失败了。长期闲置、盲区、重复项、存档、回收站和备份，各自指出一类需要收拾的东西。
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep2Body2: 它们都不会去多轮询什么：这些数字本来就在磁盘上，只是一直没地方显示。点一个数字，就落到它背后那些行上，并且已经过滤好了。
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep3Title: 每个都有几项设置，不多
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep3Body1: 它统计什么、显示几行、叫什么名字、有多宽。标题留空，磁贴就用它类型自带的名称。有行没显示出来的磁贴会说明一共有多少，因为「十二个里的五个」不该看起来像「五个里的五个」。
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep3Body2: 「显示」能把小组件从仪表板上撤下来，同时不删除它、也不丢失它的设置——和仪表板上「关闭」写的是同一个开关。
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep4Title: 自定义小组件：任何用 JSON 回答的地址
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep4Body1: 给它一个地址，然后用字段在返回结果中的路径把你想要的值点出来——totalRecords、cpu.load、data.0.name。每一个都会变成磁贴上的一个数字，标签由你定，形态也由你选：计数、百分比、字节、时长、日期，或者纯文本。
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep4Body2: 指向列表的路径也行，所以一个返回条目的接口可以画成一行行，而不是几个数字。没有针对某个服务写死的东西：只要它能用 HTTP 讲 JSON，它就能变成一块磁贴。
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep5Title: 已经写好的二十八种服务
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep5Body1: 挑一个预设，地址的形状、字段和标签就都已经写好了——媒体服务器和下载器、网络设备、机器本身，还有日常应用。你是在这个基础上改，而不是对着一张空表单发愁。
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep5Body2: 预设是起点，不是枷锁：改一条路径、去掉一个数字、指向另一台主机都行。而还没人写过的服务，用的就是同一张表单，只是字段留空。
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep6Title: 请求由服务器发出，密钥也留在那边
dashboard.widgetsTutorialAuthHint: 保存在运行 nextDash 的那台机器上，不进页面，也不进你的备份
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep6Body1: 磁贴的地址是 nextDash 自己去取的，不是你的浏览器。正因为如此，小组件才能读到你浏览器根本访问不到的服务，也才能让令牌不出现在任何人都能查看源码的页面里。
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep6Body2: 它和其他所有出站请求受同样的保护——地址检查和速率限制——而需要登录的小组件会在磁贴上直说，而不是悄悄失败。
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep7Title: 在页面上它的行为和分类一样
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep7Body1: 拖动标题里的 // 就能在分类之间挪动它，点标题栏可以折叠收起，右键则有重命名、宽度、设置和关闭。方向键会走进磁贴并逐行浏览，在某一行上按 Enter 就等于点它。
dashboard.widgetsTutorialStep7Body2: 这里的一切在这个标签页上也都有：「添加小组件」会打开目录，「类型」则在你挑之前先介绍每一种。
dashboard.themeBrowserNoticeTitle: 你的仪表板可以是任何样子
dashboard.themeBrowserNoticeBody: 两百多个主题，做成可以搜索的网格，而不是要一直往下滚的列表。你看着哪个，它就在这个页面上预览哪个，选定之前什么都不保存——所以试一试不花任何代价。

config.widgetCustomTtlInfoMessage:
这块磁贴读的是你自己的服务。这个数字就是它多久读一次——磁贴会按这个间隔自己刷新，不需要重新加载页面。

介于 30 秒和 24 小时之间。留空则为 5 分钟。

按你测的东西来定：下载速度或处理器负载用 30 到 60 秒，队列或计数用 5 分钟，本来就每小时才测一次的用一小时。问得比服务自己测得还勤，拿回来的还是同一个答案。

config.statsInfoInboxMsg: 你的收件箱情况如何。「当前收件箱」显示此刻排着队的东西，包括未读条目有多陈旧。「分拣吞吐」跟踪累计计数——你存了多少链接、转成了多少书签、丢弃了多少——转化率则说明你的收件箱到底是个有用的队列还是个黑洞。累计计数从开始跟踪那天算起，更早的活动不包含在内。
config.statsInfoHealthMsg: 健康视图的汇总。「健康」的书签通过了每一项检查；「失效」的没通过可达性检查；「未检查」的还没测过。明细里数的是健康视图标出的其他问题——重复网址、快捷方式冲突、陈旧的检查、缺少预览，以及未使用的书签。从仪表板打开健康视图可以逐个查看和修复书签。
config.statsInfoInsightsMsg: 从你的收藏里自动挑出的亮点：最忙的页面、排第一的书签、从未打开的占比、状态覆盖率，以及最近 48 小时的活动。链接会跳到下面相关的分区。
config.statsInfoScoreMsg: 一个基于收藏健康度的 0–100 分。扣分项：从未打开的书签（最多 −25）、超过 90 天没访问的（最多 −20）、重复的网址（最多 −15）、冲突的快捷方式（最多 −10）。
config.statsInfoActivityMsg: 迷你图数的是「最后打开时间」落在每个时间段里的书签——这是个「最近程度」视图，不是单次打开。总数把时段内活跃（最后打开时间落在窗口内）的书签的累计打开次数加起来。「全部时间」用的是最近 12 个月。
config.statsInfoTopMsg: 选了时段之后，只列出在那个窗口内打开过的书签。「打开次数」显示的是累计次数，不是时段内的次数。柱子是相对列表里最高值来画的。
config.statsInfoPagesMsg: 每个页面的书签数。加了时段过滤之后，只统计在那个窗口内打开过的书签；「打开次数」把它们的累计次数加起来。柱子反映的是相对最忙那个页面的总量。
config.statsInfoCategoriesMsg: 每个分类和页面的书签数。加了时段过滤之后，只统计在那个窗口内打开过的书签；「打开次数」把它们的累计次数加起来。
config.statsInfoTagsMsg: 标签在你整批收藏里的覆盖情况。加了时段过滤之后，打开总数只包含在那个窗口内打开过的书签，而且显示的是累计次数——不是时段内的次数。
config.statsInfoShortcutsMsg: 覆盖率条显示有多少书签配了快捷方式。表格按打开次数列出前 20 个快捷方式。
config.statsInfoFindersMsg: 「查找器」标签页里自定义搜索查找器的使用统计。你从仪表板打开一个查找器时，useCount 就加一。
config.statsInfoRotMsg: 「从未打开」列出打开次数为零的书签。「陈旧」列出在所选时段内没有打开过的书签。可以用健康页面把它们归档或删掉。
config.statsInfoConflictsMsg: 「重复的网址」是指向同一个地址的书签。「快捷方式冲突」发生在一个快捷方式被分配给不止一个书签的时候。可以在健康页面解决它们。
config.statsInfoSearchMsg: 你当前搜索和监控设置的快照：搜索索引建好了没有、哪些模式在生效，以及有多少书签开启了状态检查。
config.urlConflictHint: 这个网址在本页面上已存在。
config.pinnedToggleHint: 把这个书签留在它所属分类的顶部
config.statusCheckToggleHint: 监视这个书签是否在线
config.tagsFieldHint: 用逗号分隔。用于过滤和动态合集。
config.shortcutUniqueHint: 快捷方式在这个页面内必须唯一。
config.shortcutFinderHint: 快捷方式和某个查找器的快捷方式重了。
config.detailEmptyHintQuickAdd: 快速添加——点 ⚡ 或 + 添加 即可创建书签
config.detailEmptyHintClick: 点一个书签即可编辑名称、网址、图标等
config.detailTagsPlaceholder: 工作, 开发, 个人…
config.statsInsightsIntro: 对你使用习惯的快速解读。
config.statsInsightTopPage: 活动最多的是 {page}，共 {opens} 次打开。
config.statsInsightTopBookmark: 排第一的书签是「{name}」，打开了 {count} 次。
config.statsInsightNeverOpened: 有 {percent}%（{count}/{total}）的书签还从未打开过。
config.statsInsightStatusCoverage: 有 {percent}%（{count}/{total}）的书签开启了状态检查。
config.statsInsightRecentActivity: 最近 48 小时内打开了 {count} 个书签。
config.statsInsightNoRecent: 最近 48 小时内没有记录到任何书签打开。
config.statsActionTopBookmarkDone: 已在这个页面上聚焦到排第一的书签。
config.statsActionNeverOpenedDone: 已在这个页面上选中 {count} 个从未打开的书签。
config.statsActionNeverOpenedNoop: 这个页面上没有从未打开的书签。
config.statsActionStatusDone: 已为这个页面上的 {count} 个书签启用状态检查。
config.statsActionStatusNoop: 这个页面上的所有书签都已经启用了状态检查。
config.themePreviewSaveHint: 预览中——点「保存」才会留下
config.themeSaveFailed: 无法保存主题——请用「保存」再试一次
config.backgroundAutoHint: 与你当前主题相配的渐变。
config.iconStylingThemeHint: 这些设置只作用于你现在用的主题——「{theme}」。其他主题各有各的。
config.iconStylingRandomThemeHint: 这些设置作用于你随机轮换里的每一个主题。
config.packedColumns: 紧凑堆叠列（分类填满高度，空白更少）
config.defaultCategorySpreadInfoMessage: 你新建的分类是否可以铺开占好几列。占几列不是一个设置项：它由「每个分类的条目数」上限和分类里的书签数量推出来。
config.defaultCategorySpreadHint: 只对从现在起新建的分类生效。已有的分类各自保留自己的开关——在仪表板上用 Shift+W 切换，或在 页面与标签 → 分类 中逐行切换。
config.categorySpreadResetScopeInfoMessage: 下面那个按钮作用在哪里：只是你当前所在的页面，还是所有页面的分类。
config.categorySpreadResetScopeHint: 下面那个按钮作用在哪里。它会把每个分类都恢复为单列；其他什么都不变。
config.categorySpreadResetConfirm: 把每个分类都恢复为单列？范围：{scope}。
config.tipEditCategorySpread: 一个分类可以铺开占好几列：右键点它的标题选 横跨多列，或者在它上面按 Shift+W。占几列由「每个分类的条目数」上限和它里面有多少书签推出来。
config.generalCategoryWidthIntro: 一个分类能长多高，以及它是否可以铺开占好几列。横跨需要下面设一个上限（不能是「不限」）并且至少有两列；横跨的分类占几列，由那个上限和它里面的书签数量推出来。切换单个分类：在仪表板上按 Shift+W、右键 → 横跨多列，或在 页面与标签 → 分类 中逐行切换。
config.categoryItemLimitUnlimitedBlocked: 不限——只要还有分类在横跨就不行
config.categoryItemLimitHint: 出现「+ N 个」折叠开关之前，每列显示多少个书签。横跨的分类保持这个高度，转而多占一列。只要还有分类在横跨，「不限」就不可用，因为那样就没什么能决定它需要几列了。
config.smartCollectionsNote: 仪表板根据你怎么用、什么时候用书签，自动填充的合集——不用维护任何规则。每个上限决定最多出现多少个。
config.tagCollectionsNote: 当足够多的书签共用一个标签时，把这个标签变成它自己的合集。把最小值调高可以把一次性的标签挡在外面。
config.smartTodayKeywordsNote: 这些词会在对应的时间段把书签往「今日」列表上顶——上班时间是工作相关的词，晚上和周末是其余的。用逗号分隔。
config.generalGroupGeneralNote: 语言、链接行为，以及作用于整个仪表板的选项。
config.generalGroupDateTimeNote: 书签上方显示的时钟、日期行和天气。
config.generalGroupQuickAddNote: 往仪表板上粘一个网址时会发生什么——直接添加，还是先收进收件箱稍后整理。
config.generalGroupSyncNote: 设置通常会跟着你到每个浏览器。把它们留在本设备上，可以让这一台有自己的外观和布局。
config.appearanceThemeNote: 挑一个内置主题，或者跟随系统。任何主题的颜色都能改，也可以在主题编辑器里自己做一个。
config.appearanceTypeNote: 整个仪表板使用的字体、字重和字号。上传字体文件即可使用列表里没有的字体。
config.appearanceBackgroundNote: 书签背后是什么。「自动」跟随你的主题；「渐变」和「图片」让你自己选，不透明度可以把它压淡，好让文字仍然清楚。
config.appearanceBrandingNote: 这个仪表板在浏览器标签页里用的页面标题和图标。
config.backgroundGradientHint: 十三个预设，从深到浅。浅色渐变配浅色主题。
config.backgroundImageUrlHint: 指向图片文件的直链。如果它让书签变得难读，就把下面的不透明度调低。
config.categoryItemLimitInfoMessage:
限制一个分类在出现「显示更多」链接之前显示多少书签。免得某个大分类把别的都压下去。

• 超出上限的行在你展开之前一直隐藏
• 设为「不限」则始终显示全部书签
• 在仪表板上按分类分别生效
config.showDockLayoutSelector: 在停靠栏中显示布局选择器
config.fontUploadSuccess: 字体已上传。随时可以在「界面字体」下拉框里选它。
config.fontUploadError: 字体上传失败。请使用 .woff、.woff2、.ttf 或 .otf（最大 5 MB）。
config.pasteUrlQuickAdd: 粘贴网址快速添加书签
config.inboxEnabledInfoMessage:
在仪表板顶栏显示「收件箱」标签，并启用粘贴到收件箱、0 快捷键和 :inbox 命令。

• 新装和已有安装默认开启
• 关闭会隐藏收件箱标签和粘贴到收件箱的选项
config.openLinksInNewTab: 在新标签页中打开链接
config.showLinkPreviewCards: 悬停时显示链接预览卡片
config.linkPreviewGroupNote: 书签旁边的一张卡片，写着页面自己说了什么、以及 nextDash 知道些什么。
config.linkPreviewModeOffBody: 这一行保留它原本的提示气泡。
config.linkPreviewModeHoverBody: 按下面的延迟时间，在行旁边出现。
config.linkPreviewModeKeyboardBody: 从不自己出现；Shift + V 为选中的行打开它。
config.linkPreviewElsewhere: 抓取到的文字和图片在 书签 → 链接预览 中管理，健康视图会列出还没有预览的书签。
config.linkPreviewSampleNote: 你为这个页面写下的备注。
config.linkPreviewSampleDesc: 页面自己是怎么介绍这个页面的。
config.linkPreviewModeInfoMessage:
预览卡片怎么调出来。

• 关：这一行保留它的提示气泡
• 悬停时：在行旁边出现
• 仅键盘：在选中的行上按 Shift + V
config.linkPreviewPartsInfoMessage:
卡片能画的每一行都是可选的。

• 没内容可说的行本来就不会画出来
• 关掉某一行，即使有内容也会隐藏
config.showPageInTitle: 在标题中显示页面名称
config.categorySpacingInfoMessage:
分类行与行之间的纵向空间。

• 紧凑 → 适中 → 宽松
• 「密度」决定书签本身的大小；这一项是它们所在行之间的间隙
config.categorySpacingAiryBody: 行与行之间留出更多空间。
config.sideMarginSnugBody: 窄边距——留给列的空间更多。
config.sideMarginAiryBody: 宽边距——各列往中间收拢。
config.sideMarginInfoMessage:
仪表板左右两侧的空白带。

• 紧凑 → 适中 → 宽松
• 窗口变窄时每个选项都会自动收窄边距，所以绝不会先挤压列
config.generalLayoutIntro: 网格结构、列数、布局预设和密度。
config.generalBookmarksDisplayIntro: 网站图标、快捷方式、徽标、链接预览、排序和导航。
config.generalSearchInputIntro: 搜索浮层的行为和建议。
config.usageAnalyticsHint: nextDash 用 Umami 来了解哪些功能被用到、这个应用还能怎么改进。我们只把它用于产品层面的洞察，比如页面浏览、功能使用和总体活跃度。不使用 cookie，不建立个人画像，也不跨网站追踪用户。统计数据只用于改进 nextDash。在你在这里勾上之前它一直是关闭的；勾上后页面重新加载才生效。关闭期间统计脚本根本不会加载，也不会有任何请求离开你的机器。
config.overviewChangedNone: 一切都还是安装时的默认值。
config.overviewNewsEmpty: 眼下没有可显示的文章。
config.showSiteNewsLabel: 在概览中显示 nextdash.cc 的文章
config.showSiteNewsInfoMessage:
项目官网最近的五篇文章，显示在配置概览上。

• 由你的服务器抓取，不是你的浏览器
• 每六小时一次，所有打开配置的人共用
• 关闭就意味着这个请求根本不会发出
config.updateCheckLabel: 到 GitHub 检查新版本
config.updateCheckHint: nextDash 每天一次向公开的 GitHub Releases API 询问有没有比你正在运行的更新的版本。不会发送任何书签或设置——只是向 GitHub 发一个 GET。默认开启；不想要的话在这里关掉。
config.updateCheckInfoMessage: 服务器会把你正在运行的版本标签和 github.com/jordibrouwer/nextdash/releases/latest 做对比。有更新的标签时，配置 → 概览 会显示提示，★ 按钮上会出现一个圆点。在你正在使用应用时，每个版本会弹一次提示。要在整台服务器上禁用，设置 DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=true。
config.updateCheckUpToDate: 你用的已经是最新版本（{current}）。
config.updateCheckFailed: 联系不上 GitHub。请稍后再试。
config.updateCheckIdleHint: 点「检查更新」把你的版本和 GitHub 对比一下。
config.updateCheckDisabledHint: 请在 配置 → 行为 → 隐私 中打开「到 GitHub 检查新版本」。
config.showHealthDashboard: 显示健康 beta 链接
config.showHealthDashboardInfoTitle: 健康 Beta 链接说明
config.showHealthDashboardInfoMessage:
控制仪表板顶栏里健康入口是否可见。

• 开：显示一个直达仪表板健康视图的链接
• 关：隐藏这个链接
config.showSearchFlowBannerInfoMessage:
在按钮上方显示一条小横幅，说明主要的搜索流程。

• > 打开搜索
• : 打开命令
• ? 打开查找器
• × 关闭横幅；之后可以在这里重新打开
config.showSmartTodayCollection: 显示「智能：今日」（智能开始）
config.smartCollectionPagesLabel: 页面（可多选，留空 = 全部）：
config.smartTodayWorkKeywordsLabel: 上班时间关键词（用逗号分隔）：
config.smartTodayEveningKeywordsLabel: 晚间关键词（用逗号分隔）：
config.smartTodayWeekendKeywordsLabel: 周末关键词（用逗号分隔）：
config.showPageNamesInTabs: 在标签中显示页面名称
config.showWhatsNewHint: 看一段最近功能的简短汇总——配置里的 ℹ 信息按钮、「基础／高级」分层、动态 PWA 清单、仪表板无障碍支持等等。
config.interleaveModeInfoMessage:
启用时：
• 按任意字母开始模糊搜索（按名称找书签）
• 按「/」再输字母使用快捷方式（例如 /yt 打开 YouTube）

关闭时：
• 按任意字母开始快捷方式搜索
• 按「/」再输字母使用模糊搜索
config.packedColumnsInfoMessage:
启用后，在较宽的屏幕上书签／分类区块会轮流分配到各列。

• 减少纵向的空白
• 可能让阅读顺序不那么自上而下
• 切换后立即保存
config.deviceSpecificSettings: 使用针对本设备的设置
config.allowLocalBookmarks: 允许 localhost 和内网书签
config.allowLocalBookmarksInfoMessage:
启用后，书签可以使用 http://localhost、127.0.0.1 和内网 IP。状态检查、链接预览、自动修复和从网址下载图标都能访问这些主机。

• 默认开启，方便本地开发
• 如果 nextDash 暴露在共享网络上，请关掉（防 SSRF）
config.globalShortcuts: 使用所有页面的快捷方式
config.globalShortcutsInfoMessage:
启用后，每个页面的快捷方式在任何地方都能用。

• 跨页面打开更快
• 如果有重复，快捷方式冲突的可能性更高
config.showBookmarkStatus: 显示书签状态（在线／离线）
config.monitorEmphasisNote: 监控中的书签在其他书签里有多显眼。离线的监控无论你选哪个都会被标出来——这里选的是健康的那些有多明显。
config.monitorEmphasisProblemsBody: 健康的监控看着和别的书签一样。只有中断才会引人注意。
config.monitorEmphasisAlwaysBody: 每个监控中的书签都有自己的强调边缘，一眼就能看出你在盯着什么。
config.monitorEmphasisNeverBody: 监控完全留在健康视图里。仪表板上不做任何标记，中断时也不做。
config.showBookmarkStatusInfoMessage:
分两层：这个开关在全局启用仪表板状态。每个书签还得在 配置 → 书签 中单独开启自己的状态检查。

• 对服务类链接很有用，但会增加网络检查
config.statusTwoLevelHint: 仪表板状态是全局的。每个书签还得在 配置 → 书签 中单独启用自己的状态检查。
config.statusEssentialsHint: 每个书签自己的检查（就像引导里那样）在「书签」下面。健康视图显示所有页面的问题。高级：重试、颜色和 ping。
config.statusEssentialsSummaryOnNone: 开 · 还没有书签开启状态检查
config.statusEssentialsSummaryOnCount: 开 · {count} 个书签在监控中
config.showPingTimes: 显示 ping 时间（毫秒）
config.skipFastPing: 跳过快速 ping 检查
config.skipFastPingInfoTitle: 跳过快速 Ping 说明
config.skipFastPingInfoMessage:
改变状态检查的运行方式。

• 关：先做一次快速连通性 ping，再做 HTTP 检查
• 开：跳过快速 ping，只做 HTTP 检查
• 如果快速 ping 在你的环境里误报，就打开它
config.statusOfflineRetriesInfoMessage:
一个书签要连续失败多少次 ping 才被标为离线。

• 默认：3
• 范围：1–10
• 数值越高，在不稳定的网络上误报越少
config.statusOfflineRetryDelayInfoMessage:
同一次状态检查中，两次重试 ping 之间的停顿。

• 默认：450 毫秒
• 范围：100–3000 毫秒
• 只在还在重试期间生效
config.statusRecheckIntervalInfoMessage:
可见的书签在后台多久重新检查一次。

• 默认：5 分钟
• 间隔越短，网络请求越多
config.healthRecheckEnabledLabel: 在后台重新检查书签健康状况
config.feedsMarkQuietLabel: 给会发布内容的行做标记，即使没有新内容
config.feedsMarkQuietInfoTitle: 给会发布内容的行做标记
config.feedsMarkQuietInfoMessage:
当「新动态」对某个提供订阅源的书签没什么新内容可报时，那一行会带一个小圆点。

• 默认关闭：订阅源一多，每行都有圆点就成了噪音
• 有新内容的行显示的是计数，不是圆点
• 这不会多抓取任何东西——它只是把「新动态」已经知道的标出来

config.helpFreshBody:
Fresh answers one question about a bookmark you already have: has the page behind it published anything since you last opened it? A blog, a changelog, a forum thread, a status page — the row itself never says, so those bookmarks get opened on the off-chance or quietly stop being opened at all.

What you see. A bookmark with something new carries a small count on its row, and the same bookmarks gather in a Fresh collection between your categories, newest publication first, with the number in its title. Opening the bookmark clears its count; the collection disappears when nothing is new, because an empty one would be a section that means nothing.

Where the feed comes from. Switching Fresh on looks for one: it reads the head of each page you have saved, notes any RSS or Atom feed advertised there, and remembers the pages that have none so they are not asked again for a month. One request per bookmark, once — it no longer depends on link previews having been fetched, which is what made Fresh look broken on installs with previews switched off. Find feeds now beside the switch repeats the round and says what it found.

Which of your bookmarks have one. Three ways to tell, quietest first. The bookmark editor shows a Feed line with the address when there is one — that is where to look when you wonder why a bookmark never says anything. A search for status:feed lists every bookmark taking part, and -status:feed the rest. And Behavior → Fresh can put a small mark on the rows that publish even when nothing is new; it is off by default, because a mark on twenty rows that are silent most of the time is the noise Fresh exists to avoid. The tab also counts it out — 12 of 40 bookmarks asked · 2 publish a feed — and if that second number is zero, an empty dashboard is the correct answer rather than a fault.

What it costs. Polling runs on the same interval as the background link checks, and every request is conditional: a site that has published nothing answers with a bare “not modified”. A feed that fails five times running is retired rather than retried forever.

What it is not. Not a feed reader. No articles, headlines or read state are stored — only how many entries are newer than your last visit. The switch is under Behavior → Fresh, and it is off until you turn it on, because it is the one feature here that makes requests to other people's servers on your behalf.

仪表板一直在听：不管面板开没开，你打的字都会进搜索行。这一项决定书签快捷方式什么时候对此作出反应。

• 按 Enter 才打开——打字只收窄列表，你输入的快捷方式排在最前。多按一个键，但每天的行为都一样。
• 停顿一下就打开——你停下大约半秒之后快捷方式自己打开。够快，而且一个越过快捷方式继续往下写的词不会被打断。但打得慢的词仍可能掉进那个停顿里。
• 一匹配上就打开——nextDash 在 v1.2.0 之前的做法。它一个键都不多花，但会吞掉以同样字母开头的普通词：在一个有 200 个快捷方式的安装上，十三个日常搜索词里有八个被从词中间截断了——「invoice」在「in」处打开了别的东西，剩下一个「voice」。

「一匹配上就打开」重新成为默认。v1.2.0 把 Enter 设为默认是个错误：它把罕见的冲突当成了常态，为了防它给每个快捷方式都加了一次按键。如果你的某个词真被吞了，另外两种模式在这儿，冲突的快捷方式也可以改名。

config.detectSoftNotFoundInfoTitle: 不声不响就没了的页面
config.detectSoftNotFoundInfoMessage:
链接腐化最常见的形式不是服务器死了。而是一个回应得好好的、却显示「页面未找到」的页面——CMS 用成功状态码送出它的错误模板、文档站吞掉了一篇被挪走的文章、商店里那个商品不再上架。任何普通检查都会说它是健康的，因为在网络层面它确实是。

打开这一项之后，监控中书签的检查会读取页面，先判断标题，再看正文的开头。命中会记为一次失败，原因写「页面自称不存在」，于是它会像其他失败一样出现在行上、中断列表里和导出中。

代价是每次监控检查多读一段有上限的正文，所以这是个选项。明确的预期仍然优先：如果你已经说过页面必须包含什么，那就以它为准。

对于那些从不明说的页面，这项检查还会问主机本身：向那个站点上一个不可能存在的地址发一个请求，每个站点每天一次。如果那个也回 200，那么来自这台主机的 200 就什么都证明不了，而长度与之相符的页面会被认定为同一回事。把所有地址都送去登录页的站点会被放过——一个带门禁的应用，对探测和对你的书签给的是同一个登录界面，看起来一模一样，实际不是一回事。区分它们的是：未找到页在被问的地方作答，而门禁会把你送去别处。

在你开始用键盘操作之前它不碍事：第一次按键之后出现，你一打开什么它就走——所以你在学的时候它教你，你不学了它就消失。

config.checkModePeriodicHint: 每天检查一次，坏了就在书签上标出来。
config.checkModeMonitorHint: 按你自己设的间隔检查，并保留在线率历史、心跳和中断告警。「定期」能做的它都包含。
config.checkModeExplainTitle: 可用性检查是怎么回事
config.checkModeExplainPeriodic: 回答一个问题：这个链接还活着吗？它在后台大约每天检查一次，坏掉的书签会在健康视图里被标出来。开销小，对大多数书签也够了。
config.checkModeExplainMonitor: 回答一个更大的问题：它到底有多可靠？它按你挑的间隔检查（最短 5 分钟）并保留历史，于是你会得到在线率百分比、心跳条、中断记录和可选的告警。用在那少数几个你真的在意它是否在线的服务上。
config.checkModeExplainWhich: 「持续监控」包含「定期」的一切，所以永远没有两个都要的理由。「定期」适合你日常的链接；「持续监控」适合你自己的服务器和仪表板。什么都监控会带来大量网络请求和一个很大的历史文件，收益却很小。
config.monitorNotifyDashboardUrlLabel: 这个仪表板的地址（用于通知里的按钮）
config.monitorNotifyTestSent: 已发送——去你的告警服务里看看。
config.pushNotifyNote: 把通知发到这个浏览器，即使 nextDash 已经关掉。每台设备都要单独授权。Chrome 在 localhost 上也能用；Safari 需要 HTTPS。
config.pushNotifySubjectLabel: 给推送服务的联系地址：
config.pushNotifyInfoMessage: 通过你浏览器的推送服务投递告警，所以即使 nextDash 关着它们也能送到。每台设备都要授权一次。需要 HTTPS，开发时用 localhost 也行；在 iOS 上必须先把应用添加到主屏幕。
config.pushNotifyEnabledOnDevice: 这台设备的通知已开启。
config.pushNotifyDisabledOnDevice: 这台设备的通知已关闭。
config.pushNotifyBlocked: 这个站点的通知被拦截了。请在浏览器设置里允许。
config.pushNotifyUnsupported: 这个浏览器不支持推送通知。
config.pushNotifyInsecure: 推送通知需要 HTTPS。Safari 不允许在 http://localhost 上用——请换一个 HTTPS 地址。
config.pushNotifyWelcomeFailed: 已注册，但第一条通知没能送达。
config.pushNotifyAskAgainDone: 邀请会再次出现在仪表板上。
config.bulkCategoryUpdated: 已更新 {count} 个书签的分类。
config.bulkStatusUpdated: 已{mode} {count} 个书签的状态检查。
config.bulkTagsUpdated: 已更新 {count} 个书签的标签。
config.removeBookmarkMessage: 确定要移除这个书签吗？此操作无法撤销。
config.moveBookmarkMessage: 选择要把这个书签移到哪个页面：
config.createAndAddAnotherTitle: 保存这个书签，并保持表单打开以便再添加一个
config.structureWorkspaceIntro: 为下面的书签列表切换页面和分类。恢复归档的页面，或者在这里设置网站图标策略。
config.structureWorkspaceFootnote: 重新排序、归档、模板、图标和合并：请用「页面」和「分类」标签页。
config.categoryDeleteChoose: 删除之前请先选择操作：
config.removeCustomThemeMessage: 确定要移除这个自定义主题吗？此操作无法撤销。
config.hyprModeInfoMessage: HyprMode 是为把 nextDash 装成渐进式网页应用（PWA）的情况设计的。启用后，点击书签会在新的浏览器标签页中打开它，然后自动关闭 PWA 窗口，模仿传统应用启动器的行为。
config.resetOnboardingHint: 在仪表板上重新显示快速开始卡片（语言、布局、天气，然后是清单），并把健康视图和收件箱里的一次性导览、以及偶尔出现的键盘提示都找回来。立即保存。
config.sessionTipsHint: 时不时在仪表板上以气泡形式显示一条键盘提示——最多每隔几天一条，同一条绝不重复，首次设置期间也绝不出现。
config.resetOnboardingButton: 重新显示快速开始卡片
config.tourReplayHint: 再看一遍某个引导导览。它会出现在它该出现的地方——健康视图、收件箱，或者它解释的那个位置。
config.tourReplayBlocked: 「偶尔显示键盘提示」已关闭，所以在你上面重新打开它之前，不会有任何导览出现。
config.tourNotSeenYet: 这一个你还没看过——它会自己出现。
config.tourReplayError: 无法把那个导览找回来。
config.tourWhereHealth: 你下次打开健康视图时
config.tourWhereWidgets: 你下次打开 配置 → 小组件 时
config.tourWhereSpread: 你下次让某个分类横跨多列时
config.resetOnboardingSuccess: 引导已重置。打开仪表板就能看到快速开始卡片。
config.resetConfigBookmarksTourFailed: 无法启动「书签」导览。请先打开「书签」标签页。
config.resetConfigBookmarksTourFailedDom: 无法启动「书签」导览。编辑器还在加载——请刷新页面后重试。
config.resetConfigBookmarksTourFailedReload: 无法启动「书签」导览。请刷新页面后重试。
config.configBookmarksTourWelcomeBody: 左边是列表，右边是详情编辑器。上方的「上下文」面板在你需要切换页面或分类之前一直收着。
config.configBookmarksTourListControlsBody: 选页面和分类、改排序、在下面搜索，用 + 书签 可以「添加并编辑」（需要保存）或者「快速添加」（⚡，立即保存）。
config.configBookmarksTourStructureBody: 「上下文」面板为下面的书签列表切换当前的页面和分类。页面或分类的排序在各自专门的「页面」和「分类」标签页里调。
config.configBookmarksTourPageFilterBody: 选择你要编辑仪表板的哪个页面。书签多的时候，可以按分类过滤或改排序。
config.configBookmarksTourDemoConsentStepBody: 可选：我们会添加一些临时的演示书签，在你结束之前再把它们删掉。
config.configBookmarksTourDemoConsentYesBody: 好——我们会拿一些随机的公开网站当例子。先来一个：列表和编辑器里的一个书签（在你点保存之前不会写入磁盘）。
config.configBookmarksTourDemoConsentNoBody: 已跳过实时演示。随时可以打开 + 书签 来「添加并编辑」或者「快速添加」（⚡）。
config.configBookmarksTourEditorDemoIntroBody: 打开 + 书签 → 添加并编辑。它会加一行并打开编辑器——弄完点「保存」。
config.configBookmarksTourEditorDemoDoneBody: 在右边编辑名称、网址、分类等等。这一行演示数据会一直待在编辑器里，直到你点「保存」——它还没上仪表板。
config.configBookmarksTourEditorDemoFailBody: 打开 + 书签 → 添加并编辑 来创建一个书签，然后在右边填名称和网址。
config.configBookmarksTourQuickAddBody: 「快速添加」（⚡）立即保存——和「添加并编辑」不同，不用再点保存。
config.configBookmarksTourQuickAddDoneBody: 「快速添加」直接写入磁盘——不用点保存。书签会出现在列表里，也会出现在仪表板上。
config.configBookmarksTourQuickAddFailBody: 打开 + 书签 → 快速添加（⚡）来添加一个立即保存的书签。
config.configBookmarksTourEditorBody: 在这里编辑名称、网址、快捷方式、分类、标签、置顶和状态。获取网站图标和链接预览也在这儿。
config.configBookmarksTourModalOpenIntroBody: 「快速添加」（⚡）打开的书签弹窗，和仪表板上的 + 按钮是同一个。
config.configBookmarksTourModalOpenDoneBody: 「快速添加」用的就是仪表板上那个 + 弹窗。名称和网址已经预填好了——点「创建」会立即保存到这个页面。
config.configBookmarksTourModalOpenFailBody: 点「快速添加」（⚡）打开 + 书签弹窗。
config.configBookmarksTourModalWizardIntroBody: 导览卡片留在底部；+ 弹窗留在中间，这样两个都能用。
config.configBookmarksTourModalWizardBody: 在小屏幕上，+ 弹窗是个简短的向导：先网址，再名称和选项。
config.configBookmarksTourModalDesktopBody: 在桌面端你会一次看到完整表单。导览卡片停在弹窗旁边，好让字段仍然看得清。
config.configBookmarksTourModalSaveIntroBody: 在这里创建会立即把书签写入磁盘——不用再点配置里的「保存」。
config.configBookmarksTourModalSaveDoneBody: 那个书签直接写入磁盘了（和只在编辑器里改不一样）。它会出现在列表里，也会出现在仪表板上。
config.configBookmarksTourModalSaveFailBody: 演示没能自动保存——你可以自己用「快速添加」（⚡）创建一个。
config.configBookmarksTourDashboardIntroBody: 仪表板工具栏上的 + 按钮打开的也是这个弹窗。接下来我们去仪表板看看。
config.configBookmarksTourDashboardHandoffBody: 接下来我们短暂地去一趟仪表板：+ 工具栏按钮用的就是这同一个弹窗。点「下一步」过去，然后你会回到这里做清理。
config.configBookmarksTourDashboardToolbarBody: 按 + 或点这个按钮，不用打开配置就能添加书签。
config.configBookmarksTourDashboardModalBody: 和配置里「快速添加」是同一张表单。这一步我们又预填了一个随机网站。
config.configBookmarksTourDashboardCreateIntroB: 在这里创建会立即保存，并在你当前的页面上显示那块磁贴。
config.configBookmarksTourDashboardTileBody: 这就是你仪表板上新的导览书签。你在配置里结束导览时它会被删掉。
config.configBookmarksTourDashboardReturnBody: 点「下一步」回到 配置 → 书签，把所有演示书签删掉。
config.configBookmarksTourSearchBody: 按名称或网址过滤书签列表。清空这个框就又显示全部。
config.configBookmarksTourBulkBody: 选中多个书签，然后用「移动到」改页面或分类，还可以置顶、改状态、刷新网站图标或者删除。
config.configBookmarksTourBulkDemoBody: 我们选中了几个书签，你可以试试「移动到」、置顶、状态、刷新网站图标或者删除。
config.configBookmarksTourBulkEmptyBody: 用列表里的复选框选中书签，批量操作就会出现。
config.configBookmarksTourFaviconBody: 选择书签图标什么时候刷新：保存时，还是只手动。
config.configBookmarksTourSaveBody: 「添加并编辑」的改动要点「保存」才会写入。未保存的编辑会被高亮出来。
config.configBookmarksTourCleanupIntroBody: 把临时的导览书签从编辑器和已保存的数据里删掉。
config.configBookmarksTourCleanupResumeBody: 欢迎回来——把临时的导览书签从你的收藏里删掉。
config.configBookmarksTourCleanupDoneBody: 所有导览书签都删掉了。你的收藏回到了导览之前的样子。
config.configBookmarksTourCleanupKeptBody: 演示书签可能还在。在列表里删掉它们，或者从 常规 → 系统工具 重新开始导览。
config.resetConfigFindersTourFailed: 无法启动「查找器」导览。请先打开「查找器」标签页。
config.resetConfigFindersTourFailedDom: 无法启动「查找器」导览。列表还在加载——请刷新页面后重试。
config.resetConfigFindersTourFailedReload: 无法启动「查找器」导览。请刷新页面后重试。
config.configFindersTourWelcomeBody: 查找器是通往外部站点的快捷搜索入口——Google、DuckDuckGo、维基百科等等。在仪表板上按 ? 加一个快捷键就能触发。
config.configFindersTourConceptBody: 每个查找器有一个名字、一个用 %s 代表查询词的搜索网址，以及一个单字母快捷方式。nextDash 会在你的浏览器里打开拼好的网址——它不搜索你的书签列表。
config.configFindersTourFieldsBody: 在这里逐行编辑：显示名称、完整搜索网址（必须包含 %s）、小写快捷方式（a–z），以及可选的、用逗号分隔的标签，方便在配置里过滤。
config.configFindersTourAddBody: 点 + 添加查找器 会得到一个空行。改改网址和快捷方式，就能对上任何你常用的搜索站点。
config.configFindersTourGoogleIntroBody: 一个常见的例子是 Google，网址 https://www.google.com/search?q=%s。快捷方式我们优先用 {preferred}，如果被占了就建议下一个可用的字母。接下来我们可以帮你添加这一行——前提是你同意。
config.configFindersTourGoogleConsentBody:
我们现在可以往你的列表里加一个现成的 Google 查找器：

• 名称：Google
• 网址：https://www.google.com/search?q=%s
• 快捷方式：{shortcut}

你仍然要在配置里点「保存」才能留下它。在你于仪表板上使用这个查找器之前，什么都不会发给 Google。
config.configFindersTourGoogleAddedBody: 这就是你的 Google 查找器。网址里的 %s 就是放搜索词的位置。在仪表板上按 ?，然后按 {shortcut} 再输入你的查询词——例如 ?{shortcut} nextdash 会用这个词打开 Google。
config.configFindersTourGoogleSkippedBody: 没关系——你可以自己用 + 添加查找器 加。在网址里放 %s 作为搜索文字的位置，再挑一个单字母快捷方式。
config.configFindersTourUsageBody: 按 ? 打开查找器模式。输入 {shortcut} 和你的词——例如 ?{shortcut} nextdash——然后回车。网址里的 %s 会被替换成你的查询词。如果你也希望查找器出现在普通搜索结果里，就在 常规 → 高级 中打开「在搜索中包含查找器」。
config.configFindersTourMaintainBody: 拖动 ⠿ 手柄可以改顺序。「移除」需要确认之后才删除。使用统计（使用次数 · 最后使用）能让你看清自己到底在用哪些查找器。
config.configFindersTourSaveBody: 查找器的改动在你点「保存」时才存下来。如果你在这次导览里加了 Google 那个例子，现在就保存，刷新之后它才还在。
config.resetConfigStatsTourFailed: 无法启动「统计」导览。请先打开「统计」标签页。
config.resetConfigStatsTourFailedDom: 无法启动「统计」导览。统计还在加载——请刷新页面后重试。
config.resetConfigStatsTourFailedReload: 无法启动「统计」导览。请刷新页面后重试。
config.configStatsTourWelcomeBody: 在开头那行下面，这就是你的统计面板：左边是快捷链接，右边是各个洞察区块。这里的一切都是只读的——在别处保存了书签或设置之后，重新打开这个标签页就能刷新数字。
config.configStatsTourIndexBody: 用左边的快捷链接可以滚到任意区块。在宽屏上，你读右边的图表和表格时索引一直可见。
config.configStatsTourOverviewBody: 页面、分类、书签、网址和快捷方式的数量——外加每个书签的平均打开次数。点 ℹ 可以看每项指标的简短说明。
config.configStatsTourScoreBody: 一个 0–100 的健康评分，配一条彩色进度条。下面的列表说明扣分项：从未打开的书签、陈旧条目、重复网址、快捷方式冲突等等。
config.configStatsTourActivityBody: 所选时段内活跃书签的累计打开次数、活跃书签的数量，以及一张「书签最后一次被打开是什么时候」的迷你图（不是每一次打开）。可以切换一周、一个月、3 个月、6 个月或全部时间。
config.configStatsTourTopBody: 「打开最多」和「最近打开」的书签表格，带页面名称和时间戳。改时段过滤，就能聚焦最近的使用情况或全时段的常客。
config.configStatsTourPagesBody: 对比各页面的书签数和打开次数，再看页面内各分类的情况。用时段按钮把统计限定在最近的活动，或者查看全部时间。
config.configStatsTourTagsBody: 看标签覆盖率、独立标签数，以及哪些标签出现在最多的书签上。表格会给标签和打开最多的带标签书签排名。
config.configStatsTourShortcutsBody: 看有多少书签配了键盘快捷方式，以及哪些快捷方式带来的打开次数最多——调整搜索工作流时很有用。
config.configStatsTourRotBody: 找出你从未打开过的书签、在所选时段内陈旧的条目，以及最近添加的链接。表格会列出值得复查或删除的候选。
config.configStatsTourConflictsBody: 重复网址和快捷方式冲突在这里计数，并附明细行。想更深入地分拣、在仪表板上一键修复，请打开健康视图。
config.configStatsTourSearchBody: 显示搜索索引是否已建好，以及状态监控是怎么配置的。改过设置或书签之后重新打开这个标签页就能看到新数字。
config.configCategoriesTourWelcomeBody: 分类就是你仪表板上的那些列。每个页面有自己的一份列表——挑一个页面，添加或重命名分类，拖动改顺序，删掉不再需要的。
config.configCategoriesTourPageBody: 用「页面」菜单来编辑那个仪表板页面的分类。不用离开「分类」标签页就能在这里切换页面。
config.configCategoriesTourAddBody: 点 + 添加分类 会得到新的一行。接下来我们可以加一个临时的「news」分类练练手——前提是你同意。
config.configCategoriesTourDemoIntroBody: 一个简短的演示能让你看清分类在仪表板上是什么样。我们现在可以在这个页面上创建「news」。
config.configCategoriesTourDemoAddedBody: 这就是你的「news」分类。名字和表情符号随时可以改。这里的列顺序和仪表板上的分类标签顺序一致。
config.configCategoriesTourDemoSkippedBody: 没有添加演示分类。等你准备好了用 + 添加分类 就行——导览剩下的部分你照样能跟着走。
config.configCategoriesTourFieldsBody: 编辑显示名称和可选的两字符表情符号。重命名时分类 id 保持不变——书签的关联不会断。
config.configCategoriesTourReorderIntroBody: 拖动 ⠿ 手柄可以改顺序。接下来我们把「news」挪到第一位，你就能看到仪表板上标签的移动。
config.configCategoriesTourReorderDoneBody: 我们把「news」挪到了第一位——去看看你的仪表板：分类标签的顺序跟着这个列表走。随时可以自己拖 ⠿ 手柄改顺序。按住分类标题（约 500 毫秒）可以就地重命名。
config.configCategoriesTourRemoveBody: 点某一行上的「移除」（红色）就能删掉那个分类。会有一个对话框让你确认；根据你的选择，里面的书签可以被移走、设为未分类或者删除。
config.configCategoriesTourCleanupIntroBody: 为了不改动你的收藏，我们现在把临时的「news」分类删掉。在下一个对话框里确认即可——和普通行上的「移除」是同一套流程。
config.configCategoriesTourCleanupDoneBody: 演示分类「news」已删除。你的仪表板回到了导览之前的样子。
config.configCategoriesTourCleanupKeptBody: 演示分类还在列表里。点「news」那一行的「移除」并确认，或者从 常规 → 系统工具 重新开始导览。
config.configCategoriesTourCleanupNoneBody: 这个页面上没有留下演示分类。想删某个分类时，在任意一行上用「移除」就行——会先让你在对话框里确认。
config.resetConfigCategoriesTourFailed: 无法启动「分类」导览。请先打开「分类」标签页。
config.resetConfigCategoriesTourFailedDom: 无法启动「分类」导览。分类还在加载——请刷新页面后重试。
config.resetConfigCategoriesTourFailedReload: 无法启动「分类」导览。请刷新页面后重试。
config.configPagesTourWelcomeBody: 页面是你仪表板上彼此独立的书签工作区。每个页面有自己的分类和书签——在这里添加页面、改顺序、删掉不再需要的。
config.configPagesTourListBody: 每一行就是一个仪表板页面。拖动 ⠿ 手柄可以改仪表板上的标签顺序。主页面不能删除。
config.configPagesTourAddBody: 点 + 添加页面 就有一个新工作区。接下来我们可以加一个临时的演示页面——前提是你同意。
config.configPagesTourDemoIntroBody: 一个简短的演示能让你看清新页面在仪表板上是什么样。我们现在可以创建一个。
config.configPagesTourDemoAddedBody: 这就是列表里你的演示页面。名字随时可以改——仪表板上用的也是这个名字。
config.configPagesTourDemoSkippedBody: 没有添加演示页面。等你准备好了点 + 添加页面 就行——导览剩下的部分你照样能跟着走。
config.configPagesTourNameBody: 在这一行里编辑名字。它会显示在仪表板的页面标签上，也会出现在配置各处的「页面」菜单里。
config.configPagesTourDashboardIntroBody: 新页面会作为标签出现在仪表板上，编辑书签时也会出现在「页面」菜单里。我们切到「书签」去指同一个列表。
config.configPagesTourDashboardDoneBody: 你的新页面出现在这个「页面」菜单里，也作为标签出现在仪表板上（顶栏）。用 1–9 或 Shift+←/→ 切换。点「← 返回仪表板」就能看到实际效果。
config.configPagesTourDashboardSkippedBody: 你添加的每个页面都会在「书签」这里出现，也会作为标签出现在仪表板上。用「页面」菜单可以逐页编辑书签。
config.configPagesTourRemoveBody: 点某一行上的「移除」（红色）会删掉那个页面和它所有的书签。会先让你在对话框里确认。主页面不能删除。
config.configPagesTourCleanupIntroBody: 为了不改动你的收藏，我们现在把临时的演示页面删掉。在下一个对话框里确认即可——和普通行上的「移除」是同一套流程。
config.configPagesTourCleanupDoneBody: 演示页面已删除。你的仪表板回到了导览之前的样子。
config.configPagesTourCleanupKeptBody: 演示页面还在列表里。点它那一行的「移除」并确认，或者从 常规 → 系统工具 重新开始导览。
config.configPagesTourCleanupNoneBody: 没有留下演示页面。想删某个页面时，在主页面以外的任意一行上用「移除」就行——会先让你在对话框里确认。
config.resetConfigPagesTourFailed: 无法启动「页面」导览。请先打开「页面」标签页。
config.resetConfigPagesTourFailedDom: 无法启动「页面」导览。页面还在加载——请刷新页面后重试。
config.resetConfigPagesTourFailedReload: 无法启动「页面」导览。请刷新页面后重试。
config.configCollectionsTourWelcomeBody: 动态合集是你仪表板上额外的列。每个合集显示符合你所定规则的书签——按标签、分类或键盘快捷方式。
config.configCollectionsTourListBody: 已保存的合集在这里列出，附带它们的匹配逻辑（与 / 或）和规则数量。任意一行都能编辑或删除——书签本身绝不会被删掉。
config.configCollectionsTourAddBody: 点 + 新建合集 打开编辑器。接下来我们可以为标签、分类和快捷方式各预填一条示例规则——前提是你同意。
config.configCollectionsTourDemoIntroBody: 学得最快的办法，是来一个每种字段各一条规则的简短演示合集。
config.configCollectionsTourDemoOpenedBody: 编辑器已经打开，里面有三条示例规则。每条规则分别用「标签」「分类」或「快捷方式」——匹配上的书签会出现在仪表板上的这个合集里。
config.configCollectionsTourDemoSkippedBody: 点 + 新建合集 打开编辑器。用字段下拉框添加规则：标签、分类或快捷方式——然后设置包含／排除和一个值。
config.configCollectionsTourTagBody: 标签——匹配带某个标签的书签（每个书签上用逗号分隔）。例如：标签包含「tour-demo」。保存时值会转成小写。
config.configCollectionsTourCategoryBody: 分类——匹配某一列分类里的书签。用分类 id（和 配置 → 分类 里一样），不是显示名称。
config.configCollectionsTourShortcutBody: 快捷方式——匹配带某个快捷字母的书签。例如：快捷方式包含「a」。用「或」逻辑时，命中任意一条规则就够了。
config.configCollectionsTourLogicBody: 「与」要求每条规则都命中；「或」则只要命中任意一条就收进来。演示用的是「或」，所以标签、分类或快捷方式命中其一即可。
config.configCollectionsTourSaveIntroBody: 点「保存」把合集存下来。只要有书签匹配，它就会在当前页面的仪表板上出现。
config.configCollectionsTourSaveDoneBody: 你的演示合集已保存。它会出现在列表里，规则命中书签时也会作为一列动态列出现在仪表板上。
config.configCollectionsTourSaveSkippedBody: 规则弄好之后在编辑器里点「保存」。合集存在设置里，会立刻显示在仪表板上。
config.configCollectionsTourSaveFailedBody: 请填一个名字和至少一条规则的值，然后点「保存」。用「或」逻辑，这样命中任意规则的书签都会被收进来。
config.configCollectionsTourDashboardBody: 打开仪表板——匹配上的合集会作为额外的列出现在你的分类旁边。把鼠标停在列标题上就能看到是哪些规则命中了。

config.helpIntro: This guide walks you through nextDash in plain language: how the dashboard feels day to day, where settings live, and which habits save time once you are past the first five minutes.
config.helpFirstHourBody:
You do not have to set anything up to start using nextDash, but these four steps turn an empty dashboard into one worth opening every morning.

  • Bring your bookmarks in. Config → Data & backups imports a browser export (Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge all produce the same HTML file), or a nextDash backup. Folders become pages and categories, so the shape you already had survives the move.
  • Split them across pages. One page per context — work, home, a project — costs nothing and keeps each screen short. 1–9 jumps between them, so more pages does not mean more clicking.
  • Give the ten you open daily a shortcut. One or two letters, typed on the dashboard, opens that bookmark. This is the single change that makes the keyboard worth it.
  • Turn on link checking under Config → Behavior if you want to know when something dies. It runs in the background and reports in the health view.

Everything else — themes, layout, weather, the toolbar — can wait until you have used it for a week and know what you actually want.
config.helpStartDailyBody:
What the keyboard-first idea looks like once it is habit:

  • Opening something you know. Type its shortcut, or > and part of its name, then Enter. No pointing.
  • Keeping a link for later. Paste it anywhere on the dashboard. nextDash offers to add it, or to drop it in the inbox if you do not want to decide where it goes yet.
  • Looking something up. ? sends your text to a search engine or any site you have defined as a finder, without first opening that site.
  • Tidying as you go. Shift+E edits the selected bookmark in place, Shift+M moves it, Shift+T tags it. Deletions go to the trash for 30 days, so being quick is safe.
  • Once a month. The health view lists dead links, duplicates and bookmarks you have not touched in a long time — the maintenance you would otherwise never get round to.

If you forget a key, ! opens the cheat sheet over whatever you are doing.
config.helpStatsBody:
Config → Statistics is the counting half of nextDash: not what is broken, but what you have and what you use. It reads the bookmarks already on disk, so there is nothing to switch on and nothing to wait for.

It is split into five tabs:

  • Overview — the headline counts: bookmarks, pages, categories, tags. The place to look when you want one number.
  • Activity — what you actually open. Most-used bookmarks, which shortcuts earn their keys, and which finders you reach for.
  • Content — the shape of your library: how bookmarks are spread across pages and categories, which categories carry their weight, and what is left untagged or uncategorised.
  • Inbox — how much is waiting, and whether the backlog is growing or shrinking.
  • Health — link rot and conflicts, summarised, with the healthy share over time drawn from the day-per-day record the health report keeps. The health view is where you fix them; this is where you see which way it is going.

Health now reports the readings the app was already taking: uptime pooled across every monitor over the last day, week and month, with the average response and the outages on record; certificates close to expiry, counted per site on the warning window you set; and how much of the collection has a copy kept here. Content carries a panel for everything that is not a bookmark — widgets, feeds, import sources, the trash and the automatic backups. Every panel has an Export as CSV button in its foot, and the time beside it follows your 12- or 24-hour setting.

Showing beside the tabs narrows every figure to one page, once you have more than one. Two things it cannot narrow: the inbox, which belongs to no page, and the health report, which the server builds for the whole collection — both say so where they are shown.

At the foot of the section, on every tab: the time the figures were worked out, Refresh to work them out again, and Export as CSV, which writes every tab's figures to a file. Visit Inbox and Health first if you want theirs in it — those two come from the server, and the export uses what has been loaded.
config.helpStatsReadingBody:
A few of the figures answer a sharper question than their label suggests:

  • Concentration — how much of your opening lands on how few bookmarks. A high number is not a problem; it usually means the shortcuts are doing their job.
  • Category effectiveness — categories nobody opens from. Often a sign the name made sense when you created it and does not any more.
  • Untagged and uncategorised — the cleanup list. Each links straight into Config → Bookmarks with that filter already applied, so finding them is one click rather than a search you have to construct.
  • Stale — bookmarks you have not opened in a long time. Worth reviewing, not worth deleting on sight: a tax form you open once a year is stale and still wanted.

Where a range selector is offered, it changes the window the figures are computed over — a quiet fortnight and a busy year tell you different things.
config.helpStatsUsageBody:
Opening a bookmark from nextDash — by click, by shortcut, or from search — adds one to its count and stamps the time. That is the whole mechanism, and it is what Activity, Concentration and Stale are all built on.

Two consequences worth knowing:

  • Opening the same site from your browser’s address bar, or from a bookmark bar you kept, does not count. A site can therefore look unused while you visit it daily.
  • A freshly imported library starts at zero for everything. Activity needs a few weeks of real use before it says anything; Overview and Content are accurate immediately.

The counts live in your own data file alongside the bookmarks, and travel with a backup.
config.helpStatsPrivacyBody:
Everything on the Statistics page is computed on your own server from your own data. None of it is sent anywhere, and it works with the machine offline.

Separately, nextDash can send anonymous product analytics — which helps decide what to build next. It is off unless you turn it on, has nothing to do with the figures on this page, and never includes bookmark names or URLs. The switch, and a plain list of what is recorded, are under Config → Behavior → Privacy.
config.helpThemesBody:
The browser. There are 214 built-in themes, and they used to arrive as a listbox of 214 alphabetically sorted lines — which puts a theme twenty positions from its own other half, shows nothing of what any of them look like, and cannot be searched. At that size a list is not navigation. It is a grid of cards now: one per family with a light/dark switch on it, so 214 becomes 107, plus a search box, segments for all, favourites, light and dark, and a star per family for the handful you actually use. Moving through it still previews on the real dashboard behind config, and leaving without choosing still puts your own theme back.

Every theme's own accent. The focus ring, the active tab and the hovered row used to be painted in the theme's success colour, because there had only ever been one accent. So every install accented green or teal whatever the theme was called. All 214 variants carry an accent of their own now; a custom theme made before this keeps accenting in its success colour rather than losing its accent.

Depth. A theme declares thirteen colours and only two are surfaces, and two surfaces cannot express depth — a card, a panel and a control were painted the same and only a border said where one stopped. A second layer is derived from what a theme already declares: a tint in its greys, a ladder of surfaces, a sheen on a card, and two large soft washes of light behind the page in the theme's own hues. Appearance → Depth offers flat, soft and rich. Flat is the dashboard exactly as it was, so preferring the old look is one control rather than a reason not to upgrade.

The backdrop. Dots, grid, lines, hatch or none. Left on auto the theme decides — most ask for dots, and the handful whose texture is part of what they are ask for something else. A background image of your own switches the washes off entirely: a background you chose was chosen instead of this, not on top of it.

Thirty-three new families in 1.4.0, each light and dark: Rosé Pine, City Lights, Tomorrow Dusk, Cobalt Ink, Iceberg Drift, Owl Hours, Polar Night, Zen Ember, Great Wave, Bamboo Panda, Synth Sunset and twenty-two more. 107 families, 214 variants.

Config → Appearance → Theme lists 74 built-in themes, each in a light and a dark version. Moving through the list previews each one on the dashboard behind config — nothing is saved until you pick one, and Esc puts back what you had.

Quick mode underneath switches the current theme between its light and dark halves without leaving the family you chose.

Follow system dark mode pairs your choice with the operating system: pick one theme and nextDash shows its light half by day and its dark half by night.

Random theme rotates through the built-ins for you — on every page refresh, or whenever you switch view or page. Your saved theme is remembered underneath; turn random off and it comes straight back. With follow-system on, only variants matching the current light or dark state are eligible.

Not satisfied with any of them? Custom themes lets you build your own palette, with a contrast check that warns when text against background would be too weak to read. A palette can be exported to a file and imported again, so one built on a laptop can be carried to another install, or shared, without restoring a whole backup over everything.
config.helpNotificationsBody:
When a monitored bookmark goes down, nextDash can tell you without you having to look.

  • Push notifications reach your desktop or phone even when no dashboard tab is open. Turn them on under Config → Behavior, allow notifications when the browser asks, and each device you approve is subscribed separately.
  • A webhook posts to whatever address or credentials you give it when something goes down and again when it recovers. Config → Behavior → Status & health → Downtime alerts has a Service picker so the message actually arrives in a form the receiving app understands, rather than a block of JSON it silently drops: Slack and Discord get a proper chat message, colour-coded red for down and green for recovered; Telegram needs the bot's API URL plus a Chat ID to know where to post; Pushover has no URL at all — it always sends to Pushover directly, keyed on an application token and user key instead; ntfy gets a plain-text line it can show as-is; and Raw JSON, the default, is nextDash's own shape for a receiver you built yourself. Only the fields the chosen service actually needs are shown — picking Pushover replaces the URL field with its two credential fields outright.

Whichever service is picked, a Send test alert button posts one synthetic failure through the exact same path a real one would take. A webhook that is wired up wrong — a mistyped chat ID, a token pasted into the wrong field — otherwise fails silently: nothing arrives, and nothing on screen says why. Testing at setup time catches that before the alert that matters is the one that goes missing.

Set how many consecutive failures count as down under Alert after, so a single blip does not wake anybody, and both channels report recoveries as well as failures, so a resolved outage closes itself out rather than leaving you wondering.

Silencing one bookmark. Alerting used to be all or nothing: a personal blog and a critical server shouted equally loudly, and the only way to quieten the first was to stop monitoring it — which also stopped recording it. Open the availability popover on a monitored row and tick Do not alert me about this bookmark. It is still checked, its history still builds, and the row still shows as down when it is down, carrying a Muted badge so it can never be mistaken for one that should have raised the alarm and did not. Only the outgoing message is withheld. Un-muting during an outage still alerts — a muted failure does not quietly use up the one alert that outage was going to send.

When many things fail at once. One upstream going down — a host, a reverse proxy, the network itself — takes every bookmark behind it down in the same sweep. Alerting for each one would post a dozen near-identical messages within a second, which is exactly the pattern Slack and Telegram rate-limit, so the alerts that mattered would be dropped by the service rather than delivered. Past a handful in a single round, they are collapsed into one message naming the first few and counting the rest. Below that, the individual messages are kept, because they name the bookmark and its error and are strictly more useful. A round that mixes kinds — an outage and a recovery together — stays expanded for the same reason, and certificate warnings are never collapsed, since each names a different host.

A recovery says how long it was down — “back online after 3h 12m” — worked out from the same history the failure count is read from. And muting is no longer one bookmark at a time: tick several rows in the health view and Mute alerts or Unmute changes them together, without touching the keyword checks or drift baselines they carry.
config.helpServerLogBody:
Config → Data & backups → Server log shows what the server has been doing — background jobs, imports, link checks, and one line per request — without needing shell access to the machine or container.

It is off by default: while it is off nothing is captured and it costs nothing at all. Switch it on when you want to watch something and off again when you are done; what was already collected is kept either way.

You can refresh it every few seconds, filter to warnings and errors, and search the whole buffer rather than what happens to be on screen. Limit it either by age (an hour up to thirty days) or by number of entries — one or the other, so lines are never dropped for a reason the setting you are looking at cannot explain.

Clear log empties it on screen and on disk. Worth knowing before you share it: anyone who can open config can read this log, including full webhook URLs where those were logged.
config.helpStartBody:
nextDash is a keyboard-first bookmark dashboard. Bookmarks sit in categories, categories sit on pages, and almost everything is reachable without touching the mouse.

The basics take half a minute:

  • > opens search — type part of a name and press Enter to open the top result
  • + adds a bookmark; pasting a URL onto the dashboard offers to add it too
  • : opens the command palette for actions like :favicons fetch
  • ? opens finders — send a query straight to Google, Wikipedia, or any site you define
  • ! opens the cheat sheet, which lists every key in one place
  • Each bookmark can have a one- or two-letter shortcut — type it on the dashboard to open that bookmark directly

A quick-start card walks you through language, layout, weather, and your starting point the first time you open nextDash. Skip it whenever you like — nothing is locked in, and every setting it touches stays reachable here in config.

Where things live. The header carries your page tabs plus icons for health, inbox, and config. Config opens as a view inside the dashboard rather than a separate page, so nothing reloads and Escape always takes you back to your bookmarks.
config.helpConfigBody:
Config is a view inside the dashboard rather than a separate page, so opening it never reloads anything. Open it with Shift + S or the gear icon in the header, and press Escape to leave again.

Every change saves the moment you make it — there is no Save button. A small indicator in the corner reports “Saving…” and then “Saved”, or tells you if something went wrong. Most changes are visible on the dashboard behind you straight away.

The sections in the left rail are:

  • Overview — what needs attention, then one dated stream of news from the project — posts from nextdash.cc, releases, and the settings each release introduced — with your own figures beside it
  • Bookmarks — every bookmark across every page, with search and bulk actions, and the defaults new ones start from
  • Pages & tags — finders, tags, smart collections, pages, and categories
  • Appearance — theme, type, background, the grid, and the button bar
  • Behavior — how the dashboard works, split into sub-tabs
  • Data & backups — backups, import, export, and maintenance
  • Widgets — the blocks on your pages that show something other than links
  • Statistics — what is actually in your dashboard
  • Help — this guide
  • About — what nextDash is, where it comes from, and where the release notes live

Sections with a lot of settings use horizontal sub-tabs across the top. Each setting has an ℹ button explaining what it does, and a ↺ appears next to anything you have changed from its default so you can put it back without hunting for the original value.

When you leave and come back — Shift + S, <, or the gear icon — config reopens on the same section and sub-tab you were on. A deep link like #config/appearance still takes priority.

The browser's Back button leaves config, the way Escape does. Moving between config sections is not a step of its own: a visit here is usually a rummage through several sections, and an entry each would turn one Back into six.

Config is deep-linkable: #config/appearance opens straight to a section, which is worth bookmarking for the panel you visit most.

Settings that follow you, and settings that do not. Settings normally live on the server, so every browser you open nextDash in sees the same dashboard. Under Behavior → General you can instead keep appearance and layout on this device, which is what you want when a laptop and a wall display should not look the same.

Finding a setting by what it is set to. Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + K matches a setting's current value as well as its name — “which one is on 8099”, “what did I set to Monitor” — and shows that value after the location, with switches read as On/Off. Settings that stay server-wide while Keep settings on this device only is on carry an all devices mark, because those are the ones that surprise you on the other machine.

Copy a page or a category. Duplicate on a page row copies its categories and asks separately whether the bookmarks come too; on a category row it copies the category with its width, icon and sort. Copies start with an empty check and open history — a copied uptime would be a claim about a URL this copy has never checked — and duplicated bookmarks come without the original's shortcut.
config.helpAppearanceBody:
Theme. Themes ship in light and dark pairs; Follow system dark mode switches between them with your OS, so a theme chosen here is really a choice of pair. The theme editor recolours any theme or builds one from scratch, with a live preview, import and export as JSON, and undo.

Favicon harmonisation recolours mismatched site favicons so they do not clash with your theme — Muted greys them back, Tinted pulls them toward your accent colour, and Overlay lays the theme over them. It is configured per theme, so the light and dark halves of a pair are set separately, and the intensity slider previews live as you drag it.

Type. The typeface, weight, and size used across the dashboard. If the font you want is not listed, upload a font file and it is used everywhere.

Background can follow your theme (Auto), be switched off, use one of thirteen gradients, or load an image by URL. Opacity fades whatever you choose so the bookmarks stay readable — worth turning down before deciding an image does not work.

Layout chooses Classic or Modern. Classic is dense and list-first and is the recommended, stable look; Modern is card-based with more breathing room and is still early beta. The grid itself — columns, preset, density, and how many bookmarks each category shows before a “show more” link — sits in Bookmarks layout at the top of this same Layout tab. Density has four levels, including Auto, which adapts to screen size and zoom.

Button bar. The four everyday buttons — add, search, commands, finders — and the extras beside them have a tab of their own: where the bar sits (center-bottom, either bottom corner, or a rail down one edge) and which buttons it carries, in one place. Hiding a button leaves its keyboard shortcut working. :buttonbar moves the bar without opening config at all.

The header line. The date, time, and weather above your bookmarks are optional and configured under Behavior → Date & weather: date and time toggle independently, with formats from compact numeric to long weekday names, and 12- or 24-hour clocks. With weather on, choose browser geolocation or a city by name, Celsius or Fahrenheit, and how often it refreshes.

On narrow screens, portrait tablets, and touch devices nextDash switches to lighter chrome by itself: the toolbar keeps only what you need most and folds commands and finders into the search overlay's > / : / ? tabs.

Link preview cards. Hovering a bookmark opens a card beside it: what the page is (favicon, title, one address and a status pill), what it says (image, description, your note, tags), and what you know about it (last check and ping, uptime, certificate expiry, Fresh count, opens and last opened, shortcut and location). A row with nothing to say is left out, so a bare link is a short card rather than empty space — and Never opened is a row rather than a silence. Display → Link preview cards holds three answers rather than a switch: Off, On hover (the default) and Keyboard only, for when you want what the card says without a panel appearing under the pointer — Shift + V opens it for the selected row in every mode. Beside them, the hover delay and a checklist of the rows the card may draw, with the card itself drawn from one of your own bookmarks as you tick.

Finding a setting here. Each tab has a filter beside Only changed — type and everything that does not match is hidden, Escape clears it. The theme list answers to typing too: open it and type the first letters of a name to jump to it, out of a hundred and fifty. Pointing at a type size shows it on the dashboard behind config and moving away puts it back, the way browsing the theme list previews colours. Branding — page title and favicon — is the tail of Display rather than a tab of its own. A custom theme can be exported as a small JSON file from its row and imported on another install, without moving a whole backup.
config.helpBehaviorBody:
Behavior is where you decide how the dashboard acts, as opposed to how it looks. Seven sub-tabs:

  • General — opening bookmarks in a new tab or the same one, global shortcuts, language, whether a page remembers where you were scrolled to, and the occasional keyboard tip. Also device-specific settings: normally your settings live on the server so every browser shows the same dashboard, but appearance and layout can be kept on this device instead — what you want when a laptop and a wall display should not look alike. The onboarding and quick-start cards can be replayed from here.
  • Date & weather — whether the header carries a clock and date, in which format, and whether weather rides along. Weather takes a city name or your location, in Celsius or Fahrenheit, and you set how often it refreshes.
  • Search — what typing a bookmark shortcut does, fuzzy suggestions for near-misses, whether finders appear among ordinary results, and whether search stays open when the box is empty.
  • Inbox — whether the inbox exists at all, and what pasting a URL on the dashboard does: add it as a bookmark, drop it in the inbox, or ask each time.
  • Fresh — whether a saved page can say how much it has published since you last opened it, and what looking for feeds has turned up so far: how many bookmarks have been asked, and how many of them publish anything at all.
  • Status & health — link checking, in layers, and the tab worth reading properly. Checks in this browser run as you look at a page. Monitored bookmarks on the dashboard controls how much of that shows up in the grid. Checks on the server run in the background whether or not anybody has nextDash open — that is the one that fills the health view. Below them sit downtime alerts and browser notifications, which say where a failure is sent, and maintenance windows, which stop a nightly restart being reported as an outage.
  • Privacy — the analytics opt-in, off unless you turn it on, with a plain list of what is recorded, and the daily check for a newer release.

Almost everything here has a matching command, which is often quicker than opening config at all — see Search & keyboard.
config.helpWorkspaceBody:
Pages & tags → Pages creates, renames, recolours, reorders, and removes pages. Use the ↑ and ↓ buttons to change the order; it matches the tab order in the header. The first page cannot be removed, and page names must be unique — renaming one onto another is refused rather than silently accepted.

Pages & tags → Categories works the same way for the categories on a page. Pick the page from the dropdown, then rename, reorder, add, or remove. The order set here is the order on the dashboard. Category names have to be unique within their page, but the same name on two different pages is fine — that is how categories are meant to work. Neither is the only route: the Page and Category dropdowns in the bookmark form each lead with ➕ New page… and ➕ New category…, so a bookmark can be filed somewhere that does not exist yet without leaving the half-filled form.

Both lists show how many bookmarks each entry holds, with a bar making the busy ones obvious at a glance — worth a look before you remove something.

Neither has to start in config any more. The pages overview (,) carries a New page row under the list, reached by click, by n, or by arrowing one stop past the last page. On the grid, a + sits beside the sort chips in a category header and holding c does the same — both act on the page you are looking at. Right-click a category header for rename, add and delete in one menu; deleting says how many bookmarks will lose their category first, since they are kept rather than removed. Categories can also be reordered from the dashboard by dragging the // prefix in a category title, and renamed with a long press on the header. Bookmarks with no category collect in an Other bucket at the end of the page.

A category can also spread across several columns. Right-click its header and pick Spread across columns, or press Shift+W on it; the same switch sits per row in Pages & tags → Categories. Its bookmarks then flow across those columns instead of down one, which suits a category of many short entries. How many columns it takes is not a setting: it follows from the items-per-category limit and how many bookmarks it holds, so it grows and shrinks with the category. With Pack columns tightly on it works too: the page packs itself around the spread category instead of leaving a clear row for it. A width above one column does need a limit on items per category — that limit caps the height of a column, and a wide category fills its limit once per column.

A category can carry an icon, and be moved from the keyboard. Right-click its header and pick Icon…, then type an emoji: the header follows what you type and Esc puts back what was there. Alt + ← / Alt + → on a focused header moves the category one place — Alt + arrow already means “move the thing under the cursor” for a bookmark. Both were stored and rendered long before there was any way to set them.

You come back where you were. A long page is a place you are somewhere in, not a document you read from the top each time. Switching pages — or opening Health, Inbox or config and coming back — puts you back at the offset you left, and so does a reload, for as long as the browser tab is open. A page that has grown shorter clamps to its new end. Switch it off under Behavior → General and every arrival lands at the top.
config.helpBookmarksBody:
The section has two tabs: List, described below, and Settings — how the list opens and how many rows load at a time, what a new bookmark starts with (availability mode, monitor interval), when a bulk delete or a favicon refresh asks for confirmation, how many days without opening counts as stale, and which archive service the See an old copy action uses.

Bookmarks lists every bookmark across every page. Search by name, URL, tag, or note; filter by page or category; and sort the result. Click a row and it expands in place into the full editor, so you never lose your position in the list.

The editor covers name, URL, icon, page, category, tags, shortcut, note, pinning, and availability checking. It fetches the title and favicon for you when you paste a URL, and warns before you save if the shortcut or URL is already used on that page. The Page and Category dropdowns each carry a + New… option, so a page or category can be created inline without leaving the form.

Add bookmark at the top of the list opens the same full form the + key uses. If the list is filtered to one page, the new bookmark starts on that page.

Tags above the list is a tag cloud of every tag you use, largest first. Click one or more to filter the list — several tags match bookmarks carrying any of them, the same OR the dashboard tag cloud uses. Select these bookmarks turns whatever the filters are showing into a ticked selection, ready for the bulk toolbar. Each tag also gets its own chip beside the count, so they come off one at a time.

Tick several rows to work on them together: move them to another page or category, add, replace, or remove tags, pin them, change their availability mode, or delete them. A delete — one row or a whole selection — offers Undo in the toast that follows. To refresh every icon at once, run :favicons fetch from the command palette on the dashboard — it re-downloads the favicon of every bookmark on every page.

On the dashboard, bookmarks behave like a small spreadsheet. Arrow keys move the selection and Shift+E opens inline edit on the highlighted row; a long press does the same with touch. A plain click opens the bookmark, while dragging a row reorders it within its category or drops it into another — a drag never opens the editor and a click never reorders. Right-click any bookmark for its actions in one menu: open in a new tab, copy the URL, edit, tags, move, select, or delete. Select and Select all in category start a selection, and right-clicking a bookmark that is already part of one switches the menu to the whole selection with the count named, so it is never in doubt what an action will touch. A deleted bookmark is recoverable from the trash for 30 days.

Pinned bookmarks float to the top of their category and sort alphabetically among themselves; the rest follow the category's sort mode — manual, A–Z, or Recent, switched from the chips in each category header. While a category is on A–Z or Recent its rows cannot be dragged, and the cursor and a short note say so rather than letting the drag fail silently.

There are several ways to add one: + opens the full form, & adds a bookmark in a single line (name | url | shortcut), pasting a URL offers a prompt, and the browser extension saves the current tab.

A link you already have. Saving a URL that is already on the same page is refused — two identical rows on one page are a mistake every time. A copy on another page is a question instead: nextDash says where it already is (“You already saved this on Work · Docs”), offers the existing bookmark as a link, and Save anyway files the second copy. The same document with work and with reference is a real thing to want, so the choice is yours rather than the app's.

Since v1.3.1 the list keeps what you narrowed it to in the address bar, so a filtered view is a link you can keep; an empty result says which filter emptied it; a selection survives a filter change, with the bulk bar naming how many of it the filter hides; bulk tag, pin and availability changes offer an undo; and a row of chips sorts by page, recently added or most opened, beside Changed in the last week.
config.helpTagsBody:
Tags are free-form labels on a bookmark, normalised on save — trimmed, lowercased, and deduplicated — and suggested by autocomplete as you type one that already exists. Renaming a tag in Pages & tags → Tags updates it on every bookmark that carries it, and deleting one removes it everywhere. Renaming a tag onto one that already exists is refused, because that would quietly merge the two with no way back. The count and bar next to each tag show how widely it is used.

In search, tag:work filters results without rearranging the dashboard. On desktop the tag cloud (/, or its corner button) scales each tag by how often it is used and lets you toggle several at once while the window stays open, matching bookmarks carrying any of them; one button clears the filter again.

Smart collections are groups the dashboard fills for you, with no rules to maintain: Today (what you tend to open around now), Recent, Stale (not opened in a long time), and Most used (ranked by open count). Each has its own limit — Unlimited means no cap — and each can be pointed at specific pages instead of all of them. They sit alongside ordinary categories and collapse the same way.

Most used is worth one note: it is built from open counts, so it only appears once you have actually opened bookmarks from the dashboard. On a fresh install it stays hidden until there is something to rank, which is expected rather than broken.

Tag collections turn a tag into its own collection once enough bookmarks share it — raise the minimum to keep one-off tags out. The “Today” keywords let you nudge that list: words matched during office hours, in the evening, or at the weekend, so work links surface on a Tuesday morning and the rest on a Sunday.

Fresh is the one collection that keys on what changed rather than on what you did. Switch it on under Behavior → Fresh: when a bookmark's page advertises an RSS or Atom feed, nextDash notes where the feed is while it fetches previews, polls it on the background re-check interval with a conditional request, and puts a small count on the row — 3 means three entries published since you last opened it. Opening the bookmark clears it. It is not a feed reader: no articles are stored, only how many entries are newer than your last visit.
config.helpSearchBody:
Search, commands and finders are three modes behind one overlay, switched by typing a prefix or clicking a tab at the top: > for search, : for commands, and ? for finders. Whatever you type stays as you switch, so a query typed in the wrong mode does not have to be retyped.

Ranking. Results are ordered by how well they match and how often you open them, so the thing you actually want tends to be first. Enter opens the top hit; ↑/↓ pick another and Enter opens that instead. Esc closes the overlay without touching the dashboard.

Filters narrow results without disturbing the dashboard layout, and combine freely with each other and with plain words — tag:work status:offline api is a valid query:

  • tag:work — bookmarks carrying a tag
  • category:news — bookmarks in a category
  • page:2 — bookmarks on one page. page:current and page:all work too, so you can widen or narrow without knowing the number.
  • status:… — by availability, for bookmarks that are checked. Accepts online, offline, broken, ok, checked and unchecked, plus pinned and unpinned. status:feed narrows to the bookmarks whose page publishes something Fresh can read, and -status:feed to the rest.
  • opened: / added: — by age, with today, week, month or year. opened:never finds the ones you saved and never went back to. Both are offered while you type, and their words are listed once the key is in.

Beyond the current page. Search normally looks at the page you are on. Start the query with @ to search every page at once — useful when you know you saved something but not where.

Two settings worth knowing, both under Behavior → Search. Fuzzy suggestions adds near-misses below the exact matches, so a typo or a half-remembered name still finds it. Keep search open when empty stops the overlay closing the moment you clear the box, which helps when you are running several searches in a row.

Faster than searching. A bookmark with a shortcut opens as soon as you type its one or two letters on the dashboard — no overlay at all. If you find yourself searching for the same bookmark repeatedly, give it a shortcut instead.

Typing never opens anything; Enter does. On the dashboard the search line is always listening, so the letters you type go there and narrow the list as you go. A bookmark shortcut is simply an exact match that leads the list: type it and press Enter. Until this release a shortcut fired the moment your query matched it exactly and no longer shortcut shared its letters — so whether your own word survived depended on which other bookmarks you happened to own, and typing invoice could open something at in and leave voice behind.

While a row is selected the letters belong to the grid — j/k move, x ticks, g starts a jump — and Esc hands them back to the search line. c is the exception: it adds a category whether or not a row is selected, so a search cannot begin with it. The shortcut field says which letters this costs you when you assign one.

Every filter also works in the negative. A leading - excludes instead of selects — tag:dev -status:pinned reads as “dev links I have not pinned” — on all six keys. Custom collections have had an excludes operator on every rule field since they were built; the bar could only say yes, which is the wrong half for a tidy-up question. status: also takes untagged, tagged, noted and unnoted: untagged was already a collection rule, a stats row and a config filter, and was the one thing the bar could not ask for.

Ctrl/Cmd + Enter opens the highlighted result in a new tab whatever the open-in-new-tab setting says, the same promise the grid has always made. The chord used to be swallowed before it reached the overlay.

What typing a shortcut does is a choice. By default a bookmark shortcut opens the moment your query matches it — a shortcut that needs a second key to finish is not much of a shortcut. Behavior → Search → Typing a bookmark shortcut offers two ways out where an ordinary word of yours keeps being swallowed: open after a short pause, which waits until you stop typing and leaves a longer word alone, and press Enter to open, where typing only narrows the list.
config.helpKeyboardBody:
